FR16-01 - Réfection d'une passerelle dans une zone humide Une commune a décidé de réparer une passerelle en bois qui traverse une petite zone humide fréquentée par les promeneurs et les classes de sciences naturelles. L'ouvrage, long de 42 m, présentait plusieurs lames fendues et deux garde-corps instables, mais sa structure principale restait saine. Avant toute intervention, l'équipe technique a ferme l'accès et installé un itinéraire provisoire. Le chantier devait être court afin de limiter le dérangement des oiseaux nicheurs observés près de l'étang au début du printemps Choix des réparations Le diagnostic a distingué les éléments réellement dégradés de ceux qui pouvaient être conservés. Dix-sept lames ont été remplacées, ainsi que quatre montants verticaux. Le bois neuf a été choisi dans une essence naturellement durable et livré sans traitement de surface agressif. Les fixations corrodées ont été retirées une par une pour éviter d'endommager les pièces voisines. Pendant les travaux, les outils et les chutes de matériau ont été déposés sur une bâche, car aucune vis ni aucun fragment de métal ne devait rester dans la végétation humide. Une attention particulière a été portée à la géométrie du platelage Les espaces entre les lames ont été maintenus à environ 8 mm pour permettre l'écoulement de l'eau tout en restant confortables pour les petites roues et les cannes. La hauteur du garde-corps a été vérifiée sur toute la longueur, et un léger défaut d'alignement a été corrigé près de l'entrée nord. Après une pluie de 18 mm, l'équipe est revenue contrôler les zones où l'eau pouvait s'accumuler La passerelle a rouvert le 6 mai 2026 après une inspection conjointe du service technique et du responsable du site naturel Le rapport final ne se limitait pas à une liste de pièces remplacées : il indiquait aussi les zones à surveiller lors des visites annuelles. Cette approche a permis de prolonger la durée de vie de l'ouvrage sans transformer une réparation locale en reconstruction complète. Le service a aussi conservé des photographies prises avant et après les travaux, avec la position des pièces remplacées. Ces images serviront lors de la prochaine inspection pour distinguer une dégradation nouvelle d'un défaut déjà connu et jugé stable lors du suivi annuel
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
FR16-01 - Repair of a footbridge in a wetland A municipality decided to repair a wooden footbridge through a small wetland frequented by walkers and science classes. The 42-meter-long structure had several cracked blades and two unstable guardrails, but its main structure remained intact. Before any intervention, the technical team has closed the access and set up a temporary route. The work was to be short in order to limit the disturbance of the breeding birds seen near the pond in early spring Choice of repairs The diagnosis distinguished between the elements which were actually degraded and those which could be retained. Seventeen blades and four vertical supports were replaced. The new wood has been selected in a naturally durable fuel and delivered without aggressive surface treatment. The corroded fasteners were removed one by one to avoid damaging the adjacent parts. During the work, tools and falling material were placed on a tarp, since no screws or metal fragments were to remain in the damp vegetation. Particular attention was paid to the geometry of the plating The spacing between the blades was kept at about 8 mm to allow the water to flow while remaining comfortable for small wheels and rods. The height of the guardrail was checked along the entire length, and a slight misalignment was corrected near the north entrance. After 18 mm of rain, the team returned to check the areas where water could accumulate The bridge reopened on 6 May 2026 after a joint inspection by the technical service and the natural site manager The final report was not limited to a list of replaced parts: it also indicated the areas to be monitored during the annual visits. This approach extended the life of the structure without turning a local repair into a complete reconstruction. The department also kept photographs taken before and after the work, with the position of the replaced parts. These images will be used at the next inspection to distinguish a new deterioration from a defect already known and considered stable during the annual monitoring.

FR16-02 - Suivi d'un atelier de fermentation en école hôtelière Une école hôtelière a organisé un atelier de fermentation pour montrer aux élèves comment la température, le temps et l'hygiène influencent un produit vivant. Les groupes ont préparé de petites quantités de légumes lactofermentés avec la même recette de base, mais dans des bocaux identifiés séparément. Les légumes ont été pesés avant l'ajout de sel. puis tassés pour rester sous la saumure. Aucun bocal n'a été considéré comme une expérience de dégustation libre: l'objectif principal était d'observer une méthode contrôlée et de tenir un journal précis. Les bocaux ont été conservés dans une armoire ventilée dont la température variait entre 19,2 °C et 21,0 °C. Chaque matin, un élève notait l'aspect de la saumure, la présence de bulles et l'état du couvercle Le troisième jour, un groupe a remarqué que des morceaux dépassaient légèrement du liquide. Le bocal a été retiré de la série pédagogique et l'incident a été discuté avec l'enseignant, qui a insisté sur la différence entre corriger une procédure et chercher à sauver à tout prix un résultat attendu. Observation et traçabilité Les autres bocaux ont évolué de manière régulière. Le pH. mesuré uniquement à titre démonstratif avec un appareil étalonné, a diminué au fil des jours. Les élèves ont comparé leurs notes avec les valeurs instrumentales sans supposer qu'un seul chiffre pouvait garantir la qualité d'un aliment. Ils ont aussi constate que la taille des morceaux modifiait la vitesse à laquelle la saumure devenait homogène, même lorsque les masses de départ étaient proches. A la fin de l'atelier, chaque groupe a remis une fiche comprenant les masses, les dates, les températures observées et les écarts par rapport au protocole. La séance a surtout servi à développer une discipline de travail: préparer proprement. étiqueter. observer sans manipuler inutilement et signaler les anomalies. Les élèves ont ainsi abordé la termentation comme un processus mesurable plutôt que comme une recette qui réussirait automatiquement Pour la séance suivante, lenseignant a demandé que chaque groupe prépare à l'avance une feuille de suivi vide Cette petite contrainte devait éviter les notes dispersées et faciliter la comparaison des observations sans modifier la recette en cours d'expérience
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
FR16-02 - Following a fermentation workshop at a hotel school A hotel school organized a fermentation workshop to show students how temperature, weather, and hygiene affect a living product. The groups prepared small quantities of lactofermented vegetables with the same basic recipe, but in separately identified jars. The vegetables were weighed before salt was added. Then stuffed to stay under the brine. No bottles were considered as free tasting experiments: the main objective was to observe a controlled method and to keep a precise diary. The jars were stored in a ventilated cabinet with a temperature between 19.2 °C and 21.0 °C. On the third day, one group noticed that pieces of brine were slightly sticking out of the liquid. The jar was removed from the teaching series and the incident was discussed with the teacher, who stressed the difference between correcting a procedure and trying to save an expected result at all costs. Observation and traceability The other jars have evolved steadily. The pH. The number of people who have been exposed to the virus, measured only for demonstration purposes with a calibrated apparatus, has decreased over the days. The students compared their scores with the instrumental values without assuming that a single number could guarantee the quality of a food. They also found that the size of the pieces changed the rate at which the brine became homogeneous, even when the starting masses were close. At the end of the workshop, each group handed over a sheet with the masses, dates, observed temperatures and deviations from the protocol. The main purpose of the session was to develop a work discipline: to prepare properly. I'm going to label it. observe without unnecessary manipulation and report anomalies. The students thus approached the training as a measurable process rather than as a recipe that would succeed automatically For the next session, the teacher asked each group to prepare a blank follow-up sheet in advance This small constraint was to avoid scattered grades and facilitate comparison of observations without changing the recipe being experimented on.

FR16-03 - Essai d'un relais radio sur un sentier de montagne Méthode de parcours Un club de radio amateur a préparé un essai de couverture le long d'un sentier de montagne utilisé lors d'événements sportifs locaux. Le but était de vérifier si un petit relais temporaire pouvait améliorer les communications entre le parking, un refuge et deux points situés derrière une crête. L'équipe ne cherchait pas une portée maximale; elle voulait identifier les endroits où la liaison devenait instable avec des antennes portatives ordinaires. Le relais a été installé sur un support à 2,4 m du sol, loin des câbles électriques et des surfaces métalliques importantes. Quatre binômes ont suivi des itinéraires définis et effectué un appel toutes les quinze minutes. Chaque appel comportait un identifiant, I'heure, la position et une phrase de contrôle connue. Le correspondant au refuge notait la lisibilité sur une échelle simple et demandait une répétition lorsque des mots manquaient. À 10:45, un binôme a obtenu une communication correcte à un endroit qui était presque inutilisable sans relais. En revanche, une zone boisée plus basse restait difficile malgré l'amélioration générale Les techniciens ont ensuite modifié légèrement l'orientation de l'antenne du relais et répété deux trajets. Le changement n'a pas été présenté comme une optimisation scientifique, car le nombre de mesures était limité et les conditions variaient avec le déplacement des personnes. Il a néanmoins montré qu'une installation stable et bien dégagée comptait autant que la puissance nominale La batterie, donnée pour 12 V, est restée au-dessus de 11,7 V pendant toute la période d'essai Le compte rendu a conclu qu'un relais temporaire pouvait aider l'organisation d'un événement, mais qu'il ne supprimait pas les zones d'ombre. Les responsables ont donc conservé des points de passage obligatoires et une procédure de secours indépendante. L'essai a surtout fourni une carte pratique des secteurs fiables et des secteurs incertains, utile pour préparer de futures équipes sans promettre une couverture parfaite. Les fichiers audio de quelques appels ont été conservés avec l'heure et le point de mesure. Ils permettront aux nouveaux opérateurs de comprendre la différence entre un signal simplement faible et une communication réellement difficile à utiliser facilement sur le terrain.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
FR16-03 - Testing of a radio relay on a mountain trail Course Method An amateur radio club prepared a coverage test along a mountain trail used for local sporting events. The aim was to see if a small temporary relay could improve communications between the car park, a shelter and two points behind a ridge. The team was not looking for maximum range; they wanted to identify where the link became unstable with ordinary portable antennas. The relay was installed on a support 2.4 m above the ground, away from electrical cables and heavy metal surfaces. Four pairs followed defined routes and made a call every 15 minutes. Each call had an ID, time, location, and a known control phrase. The correspondent at the shelter noted the readability on a simple scale and asked for a repeat if words were missing. At 10:45 a.m., a pairing got a proper communication at a location that was almost unusable without a relay. However, a lower wooded area remained difficult despite the general improvement. The technicians then slightly changed the orientation of the relay antenna and repeated two routes. The change was not presented as a scientific optimisation, as the number of measures was limited and conditions varied with the movement of people. It nevertheless showed that a stable and well-cleared installation was as important as the rated power The battery, given for 12 V, remained above 11.7 V throughout the test period The report concluded that a temporary relay could help with the organisation of an event, but that it did not remove shady areas. The authorities have therefore maintained mandatory crossing points and an independent rescue procedure. The trial provided a practical map of reliable and uncertain sectors, useful for preparing future teams without promising perfect coverage. The audio files of some calls were kept with the time and measurement point. They will enable new operators to understand the difference between a merely weak signal and a really difficult communication that is easy to use in the field.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FR12-01 - Inventaire des arbres urbains après une vague de chaleur Après une période de chaleur exceptionnelle, le service des espaces verts d'une ville moyenne a lancé un inventaire ciblé des arbres situés le long de trois avenues très minérales. L'objectif n'était pas de classer toute la population arborée, mais de repérer rapidement les sujets qui montraient des signes de stress et de comparer leur état avec les informations d'entretien disponibles. Les agents ont utilisé une fiche commune afin que les observations restent comparables d'un quartier à l'autre Pour chaque arbre, la fiche indiquait l'espèce, le diamètre approximatif du tronc, la largeur de la fosse de plantation et l'état visuel du feuillage Une catégorie séparée signalait les branches cassées, les blessures récentes et les signes de tassement du sol Les équipes ont également noté la présence d'un revêtement imperméable à moins de 50 cm du tronc. Les relevés ont commencé tôt le matin, car une inspection en plein milieu de journée aurait été moins confortable et aurait pu inciter les agents à accélérer les observations Des symptômes à la décision Sur 186 arbres examinés. trente-deux présentaient une perte de feuilles nettement plus importante que les autres sujets de la même espèce. Ce chiffre n'a pas été interprété comme un taux de mortalité Plusieurs arbres avaient déjà subi des travaux de voirie ou disposaient de fosses très petites. Les dossiers d'arrosage ont montré que deux rues avaient reçu des apports irréguliers pendant une semaine de restriction Le service a donc séparé les problèmes urgents. comme une branche dangereuse, des symptômes qui demandaient seulement une surveillance renforcée Un programme d'intervention a été organisé sur quatre semaines. Les jeunes arbres ont reçu un arrosage profond à intervalles définis, tandis que certains pieds ont été protégés contre le piétinement Là où cela était possible, une petite surtace imperméable a été retirée autour des fosses pour faciliter linfiltration. Les agents ont évité les tailles sévères, jugées inutiles sur des arbres déjà stressés. Une nouvelle visite a été programmée pour la fin septembre alin de vérifier l'évolution du feuillage et l'état des branches. L'inventaire a surtout amelioré la qualité des décisions. Au lieu de traiter tous les arbres de la même manière, le service disposait désormais d'observations datées, de photos et d'un historique d'entretien. Les données ne remplaçaient pas l'expertise d'un arboriste pour les cas complexes, mais elles facilitalent la priorisation des visiles et la communication avec les habilants qui signalaient un arbre en difficulté
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
FR12-01 - Inventory of urban trees after a heat wave Following an exceptionally hot period, the Green Spaces Department of a medium-sized city launched a targeted tree inventory along three very mineral-rich avenues. The aim was not to classify the entire tree population, but to quickly identify subjects who showed signs of stress and compare their condition with available maintenance information. The officers used a common chart to ensure that observations were comparable from one neighbourhood to another For each tree, the chart indicated the species, the approximate diameter of the trunk, the width of the planting pit and the visual condition of the foliage A separate category reported broken branches, recent injuries and signs of soil settlement The teams also noted the presence of waterproof coating within 50 cm of the trunk. Sampling began early in the morning, as a midday inspection would have been less comfortable and could have prompted officers to speed up the observations of symptoms to decision on 186 trees examined. Thirty-two had significantly more leaf loss than other subjects of the same species. This figure has not been interpreted as a mortality rate. Several trees had already undergone road works or had very small pits. Irrigation records showed that two streets had received irregular supplies during a week of restrictions. A programme of intervention was organised over four weeks. The young trees were deeply watered at defined intervals, while some of the stems were protected from stomping. Where possible, a small waterproof cover was removed around the pits to facilitate water infiltration. Officers avoided the harsh pruning, which was deemed unnecessary on already stressed trees. A further visit was scheduled for the end of September to check the development of foliage and the condition of the branches. The inventory has mainly improved the quality of decisions. Instead of treating all trees in the same way, the department now had dated observations, photographs and a maintenance history. The data did not replace the expertise of an arborist for complex cases, but it made it easier to prioritize sightings and communicate with tree dressers who signalled a tree in distress
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FR12-02 - Contrôle climatique d'une réserve de textiles Un petit musée municipal conserve des costumes, des drapeaux et des fragments de tissu dans une réserve qui n avait pas été rénovée depuis plusieurs années Lorsque de nouvelles étagères ont eté installées. la conservatrice a profité du déplacement des collections pour vérfier les conditions climatiques de la pièce. Trois enregistreurs autonomes ont été placés à des hauteurs diffèrentes, loin des fenêtres et des sorties d'air directes. Ils ont mesuré la température et I'humidité relative toutes les dix minutes pendant six semaines. Mesures et réorganisation La température est restée relativement stable, entre 18,4 °C et 21,6 °C, mais I'humidité relative a montré des variations plus rapides Une zone proche du mur extérieur dépassait parfois 65% après de fortes pluies Les boites stockées à cet endroit ne présentaient pas de dommage visible pourtant l'équipe a choisi de les déplacer avant que le problème ne devienne chronique Un contrôle du batiment a ensuite révélé qu'une descente d'eau pluviale fuyait légèrement à Fextérieur La réserve a été réorganisée pour créer une circulation d'air plus régulière autour des rayonnages Les textiles lourds ont éte répartis sur plusieurs niveaux afin d'éviter une charge excessive sur une seule tablette. Les pièces fragiles ont reçu des supports neutres adaptés à leur forme, et les étiquettes anciennes ont été remplacées lorsqu'elles risquaient de se détacher Chaque déplacement a été enregistré dans la base de localisation; aucune boite n'a changé de place sans mise à jour de son numéro d'étagère Après la réparation de la descente d'eau. les capteurs ont continué à enregistrer pendant deux semaines La zone problématique n'a plus montré de hausse brutale, même pendant un épisode pluvieux de 27 mm La conservatrice a toutefois décidé de maintenir un capteur sur ce mur pendant toute la saison humide Cette décision reposait sur un risque connu et documenté, plutôt que sur l'idée que la réparation avait définitivement supprimé toute possibilité de vaniation Le projet a rappelé qu'un bon stockage ne dépend pas seulement d'une tempéralure moyenne La prendre une mesure corrective
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
FR12-02 - Climate control of a stock of textiles A small municipal museum keeps costumes, flags and fragments of cloth in a reserve that had not been renovated for several years when new shelves were installed. The curator took advantage of the relocation of the collections to verify the climatic conditions of the room. Three independent recorders were placed at different heights, away from windows and direct air outlets. They measured the temperature and relative humidity every ten minutes for six weeks. Measures and reorganisation The temperature remained relatively stable, between 18.4°C and 21.6°C, but relative humidity showed faster variations An area close to the outer wall sometimes exceeded 65% after heavy rains The boxes stored there did not show any visible damage yet the team chose to move them before the problem became chronic A building inspection later revealed that a rainwater drain was leaking slightly to the outside The reserve was rearranged to create more regular air circulation around the racks The heavy textiles were spread over several levels to avoid excessive load on a single table. Fragile pieces were given neutral supports adapted to their shape, and old labels were replaced when they were in danger of breaking off. Each movement was recorded in the location database; no box changed place without updating its shelf number after the waterfall was repaired. the sensors continued to record for two weeks the problem area no longer showed a sharp rise even during an episode of 27 mm rain the conservator however decided to keep a sensor on this wall throughout the wet season this decision was based on a known and documented risk, rather The Commission's proposals for a directive on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the safeguarding of employees' rights The project recalled that good storage does not depend only on an average temperature
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FR12-03 - Audit de la chaîne du froid dans une coopérative laitière Une coopérative laitière qui collecte le lait de plusieurs fermes a réalisé un audit iniene de sa chaine du froid avant la période la plus chaude de l'année Les responsables voulaien vénfier le temps écoulé entre la traite, le refroidissement à la ferme. le transport el l'amvée au cenire de collecte Pendant cinq jours, des enregistreurs de température ont été placés dans quaire citenes représentatives Les chauffeurs ont également noté les heures de départ les arrèis et les éventuels retards sur un formulaire standardisé Les données ont moniré que la majorité des trajets restaient dans la plage attendue, mais un tnéraire du mardi présentait une hausse progressive pendant les quarante dernières minules L'équipe a d'abord vérfié si le capteur avait été mal placé Après confirmation de sa position, elle a inspecté la citerne et découvent qu'un joint de trappe étail usé Le joint a été remplacé avant le trajet suivant Cette séquence a été conservée dans le rappon afin de monirer comment une anomalie instrumentale apparente peut conduire à une vérification matérielle utile L'audit s est également intéressé aux delais Le parcours le plus long devail normalemeni durer 2 h 15, mais il a atteini 2 h 48 un jour de travaux routiers La température n'a pas dépassé la limite interne, cependant la marge de sécurité était plus faible La coopérative a donc défini un tinéraire secondaire et demande aux chauffeurs de signaler immédiatement tout arrêt imprévu supeneur à quinze minutes Les décisions ne reposaient pas sur un seul indicateur. mais sur la combinaison du temps. de la température et de l'étar du matériel Contrôles à la réception Au centre de collecte, les sondes portatives utilisées pour les contrôles ponctuels oni été comparées avec une référence Deux appareils affichaient un écant supeneur à O 6 °C el ont été retirés jusqu'à recalibrage Les opérateurs ont aussi revu la méthode de nettoyage des sondes entre deux lots afin d'éviter de transformer une procédure de mesure en source de contamination. Une fiche plastifiée a été placée près du poste de réception pour rappeler la séquence correcte A la fin de l'audit. la coopérative n'a pas conclu que sa chaine du froid étail parlaite Elle a plutót identifié des points de contrôle mesurables élat des joints, fiabilité des sondes, durée des trajets el réaction aux retards Un second audit, plus court, a été programmé six semaines plus tard pour vérifier que les actions décidées étaient réellement appliquées sur le terrain

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
FR12-03 - Audit of the cold chain in a dairy cooperative A dairy cooperative which collects milk from several farms carried out an in-house audit of its cold chain before the hottest time of year. The data showed that the majority of journeys remained within the expected range, but one Tuesday morning showed a gradual increase over the last 40 minutes The team first checked whether the sensor had been misplaced After confirming its position, they inspected the tank and discovered that a single worn-out trap joint had been replaced before the next trip The driver therefore requested that this sequence be kept within the normal range to indicate how an apparent instrumental anomaly could lead to a secondary check of the temperature of the tank. The secondary inspector was also concerned that the temperature of the tank did not exceed 15 degrees Fahrenheit, however, and that it was not useful to rest for more than two days. The driver was not immediately informed of the delay, but the secondary inspector did not have to rest for more than 48 hours. It's about the combination of time. temperature and condition of the equipment Checks at reception At the collection centre, the portable probes used for spot checks were compared with a reference Two devices had a gradient above O 6 °C and were removed until recalibration The operators also revised the method of cleaning the probes between batches to avoid turning a measuring procedure into a source of contamination. A plastic sheet was placed near the receiving station to remind the correct sequence at the end of the audit. The co-operative did not conclude that its cold chain was stable. Rather, it identified measurable checkpoints for joint width, probe reliability, travel time and reaction to delays. A second, shorter audit was scheduled six weeks later to verify that the actions decided were actually being implemented in the field.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

It's about the combination of time. temperature and condition of the equipment Checks at reception At the collection centre, the portable probes used for spot checks were compared with a reference Two devices had a gradient above O 6 °C and were removed until recalibration The operators also revised the method of cleaning the probes between batches to avoid turning a measuring procedure into a source of contamination. A plastic sheet was placed near the receiving station to remind the correct sequence at the end of the audit. The co-operative did not conclude that its cold chain was stable. Rather, it identified measurable checkpoints for joint width, probe reliability, travel time and reaction to delays. A second, shorter audit was scheduled six weeks later to verify that the actions decided were actually being implemented in the field.

ZH16-01-城市屋顶雨水收集试验 一所职业学院在教学楼屋顶开展了小规模雨水收集试验，目的是让学生观 察降雨、屋面面积和储水量之间的关系。试验系统没有接入生活用水管 网，只为绿化浇灌和设备清洗提供非饮用水。屋顶有效汇水面积约为86平 方米，落水管前端安装了可拆洗滤网，并设置初期弃流装置。2026年6月 18日第一次记录完整降雨过程时，值班学生同时抄录了校内气象站的降雨 量和储水桶液位。 过滤与记录 最初的两次降雨暴露出一个简单问题：滤网上的树叶会明显降低进水速 度。一次12.6毫米的降雨中，理论可收集水量并没有完全进入储水桶，溢 流水反而从屋檐附近排走。维护人员清理滤网后，又在进水口上方加了一 层较粗的拦叶网，使大块杂物在到达细滤网前被截住。修改后的系统在下 一场8.4毫米降雨中运行更稳定，学生也能更清楚地区分“降雨不 足”和“入口受阻”这两种情况。 储水桶外侧标有容量刻度，每次记录都包括起始液位、结束液位、降雨量 和明显的溢流情况。为了避免把蒸发或前一次残留水量误认为本次降雨成 果，课程要求学生按同一时间窗口读取数据。教师还强调，雨量计与屋顶 实际受雨情况并不完全相同，风向、屋面坡度和初期弃流都会造成差异， 因此试验的重点是建立可重复的记录方法，而不是追求某个固定的收集效 率。 一个月后，班级根据数据调整了绿化用水安排。储存的雨水优先用于距离 教学楼最近的花坛，避免用小车长距离搬运。系统旁增加了醒目的“非饮 用水”标识，并规定长期无雨后重新使用前要先检查气味、颜色和容器内 部情况。这个试验规模很小，却让学生看到，简单的节水设施同样需要过 滤、标识、维护和数据记录，才能从演示装置变成可管理的工程系统。

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
ZH16-01- Urban rooftop rainfall collection experiment A vocational college conducted a small-scale rainfall collection experiment on the roof of a school building to get students to observe the relationship between rainfall, roof area and water storage. The experimental system does not connect to the residential water supply network and provides non-potable water only for green irrigation and equipment cleaning. The roof has an effective drainage area of about 86 square meters, and a removable flush net has been installed at the front of the falling water pipes, and an initial drainage system has been installed. On June 18, 2026, when the first full rainfall was recorded, the students on duty simultaneously transcribed the rainfall and the water level of the water tank stored at the school's weather station. Filtering and recording the first two rains exposed a simple problem: the leaves on the netting significantly slowed the rate of water entry. In a single 12.6 mm rainfall, theoretically the water collected does not enter the reservoir completely, and the overflow drains away from near the roof. After cleaning the netting, the maintenance crew adds a thicker layer of barrier netting above the inlet to stop the large debris before it reaches the net. The modified system operates more steadily in the next 8.4 mm of rainfall, and students are more aware of the two scenarios of insufficient rainfall in the area and blocked entrance of mud. The outer side of the tank is marked with a capacity mark, and each record includes the initial liquid level, the final liquid level, the amount of rainfall and the apparent overflow conditions. In order to avoid mistaking evaporation or previous residual water for the result of this rainfall, the course requires students to read the data in the same time window. The teacher also emphasized that the rainfall measurement is not exactly the same as the actual rainfall on the roof, and that wind direction, roof slope and initial runoff will all make a difference, so the focus of the experiment is to establish a repeatable recording method, rather than pursuing a fixed collection efficiency. A month later, the class adjusted the green water arrangement based on the data. Stored rainwater is preferred for use in flower beds near the school building, avoiding transportation by small trucks. A distinctive non-drinking water fountain logo was added to the system, and it was stipulated that the smell, color and condition of the container should be checked before re-use after a long period of no rain. This small-scale experiment shows students that even a simple water-saving facility needs filtering, labeling, maintenance, and data recording before it can be transformed from a demonstration device into a manageable engineering system.

ZH16-02-小型无人船的河道测绘练习 某高校测绘社团在一段封闭管理的人工河道内使用小型无人船进行训练。 船体搭载卫星定位模块、测深传感器和低速无线链路，任务是沿预先规划 的航线记录水深变化，而不是进行正式水文调查。训练区长约420米，水 面较平静，两端都设有岸边观察员。下水前，操作员检查螺旋桨、天线和 电池固定带，并确认手动接管开关能够立即停止自动航行。 第一条航线由十六个航点组成，设定速度为每秒1.2米。无人船在开阔水 面上能够稳定跟踪路径，但靠近一处混凝土弯道时出现连续偏移。观察员 没有直接修改测深数据，而是先查看定位状态和船体姿态记录。结果发 现，弯道附近高墙使卫星信号质量下降，同时侧风把船头推向外侧。第二 次航行降低了该区域的速度，并把两个航点向河道中央移动约3米，路径 误差明显减小。 异常点处理 测深数据也需要质量检查。传感器在水草密集位置偶尔给出突然变浅的读 数，与前后点变化不一致。社团成员在地图上保留这些原始点，并用标记 注明“疑似水草反射”，没有直接删除。随后他们从岸边使用带刻度测杆 抽查了三个位置，确认其中两个异常点并不代表真实河床起伏。这个过程 让学生理解，自动采集的数据仍然需要结合环境和独立检查来解释。 训练结束后，所有航迹、深度记录和操作日志按日期归档。报告中特别区 分了“传感器读数”“经现场核查的读数”和“尚未确认的异常值”。社 团计划下一次加入更严格的重复航线测试，以比较同一路径在不同风速下 的差异。此次练习没有追求漂亮的三维图，而是把重点放在安全接管、异 常保留和可追溯的数据处理上。

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
ZH16-02- A small unmanned riverboat mapping exercise for a university mapping society using a small unmanned boat for training in a closed managed artificial river. The vessels are equipped with satellite positioning modules, depth sensors and low-speed wireless links, and are tasked with recording depth changes along pre-planned routes, rather than conducting formal hydrological surveys. The training area is about 420 meters long, the water is calm, and there are shore observers at both ends. Before the dive, the operator checks the propeller, antenna and battery fastener and confirms that the manual take-off switch can stop automatically immediately. The first route consists of sixteen runways with a speed of 1.2 m/s. The drones are able to steadily track the path on open water, but there is a continuous deflection when approaching a concrete tunnel. The observer does not directly modify the depth measurement data, but first checks the position and body posture records. The results showed that the high walls near the tunnel reduced the quality of the satellite signal, while the side winds pushed the boat's bow outwards. The second voyage slowed down the area and moved the two points of navigation about 3 meters to the center of the canal, significantly reducing the error of course. Data processing at abnormalities also requires a quality check. The sensor occasionally gives sudden shallow readings in densely watered areas, which are inconsistent with the change in the anterior and posterior dots. The members of the society kept these original points on the map and did not directly delete them, with the markings indicating that the moss is suspected of reflecting water grass moss. They then sampled three locations from the shore using a ribbon gauge, confirming that two of the anomalies did not represent real riverbed swings. This process helps students understand that the data collected automatically still needs to be interpreted in conjunction with environmental and independent checks. At the end of the training, all flight tracks, depth records and operations logs are archived by date. The report specifically distinguishes between lithium sensor readings that have been verified in the field and abnormal values that have not yet been confirmed. The society plans to add a more rigorous repeat route test next time to compare differences in the same route at different wind speeds. This exercise does not seek beautiful 3D graphics, but instead focuses on secure takeover, exception retention and traceable data processing.

ZH16-03-山区自动气象站的冬季维护 现场检查流程 一座山区自动气象站在冬季前进行年度维护。站点海拔约2140米，主要 记录气温、相对湿度、风速、风向和降水。由于冬季道路可能结冰，维护 人员希望在10月底之前完成传感器检查和备用电源测试。到达现场后，工 作人员先拍摄设备整体状态，再查看立杆、拉线和防雷连接是否松动。所 有拆下的螺钉都放入带盖盒中，避免掉入碎石和积雪区域。 风速传感器是本次检查的重点。过去一个月的记录中，有两段时间出现风 速长时间保持不变的现象。现场转动风杯时能感到轻微阻力，拆开防护罩 后发现内部积有细小砂尘。清洁并重新安装后，风杯转动恢复顺畅。工作 人员没有删除原有异常数据，而是在维护日志中标明检查时间和可能原 因，便于后续分析人员判断哪些时段需要谨慎使用。 电源系统由太阳能板、充电控制器和蓄电池组成。中午测试时，面板表面 部分被薄雪覆盖，清理前后的充电电流差异明显。蓄电池静置电压为12.5 V，接入站点负载后仍保持稳定。维护人员同时检查了防水接头和电缆弯曲 处，因为低温会使老化护套更容易开裂。两个出现硬化迹象的扎带被更 换，并在电缆入口处重新固定应力释放。 离站前，团队让气象站连续运行四十分钟，并将实时数据与手持温湿度仪 和便携式风速仪进行简单对照。这个对照不能代替正式校准，但能发现明 量减少已知风险，并让任何后续异常都有清晰的背景记录。

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
ZH16-03- Winter maintenance on-site inspection process of a mountain automatic weather station An automatic weather station in the mountains performs annual maintenance before winter. The site is located at an altitude of about 2140 meters above sea level and records mainly temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction and precipitation. Due to the possibility of freezing roads in winter, maintenance workers hope to complete sensor inspection and backup power testing by the end of October. Upon arrival at the site, the staff takes pictures of the overall condition of the equipment and then checks whether the poles, the tow lines and the mine-proof connections are loose. All the torn screws are placed in a ribbon-covered box to avoid falling into debris and snow areas. Wind speed sensors are the focus of this test. In the last month, there have been two periods of sustained winds in the record. A small resistance can be felt when the windshield is turned on the spot, and when the protective cover is removed, it is found that there is a small accumulation of sand dust inside. After cleaning and reinstalling, the windshield rotates back to normal. Staff did not delete the original data of anomalies, but instead indicated the time of inspection and possible reasons in the maintenance logs, allowing subsequent analysts to determine which times should be used with caution. The power system consists of a solar panel, a charging controller and a battery. During the midday test, the panel surface was partially covered in thin snow, clearing the difference in charging current before and after. The battery has a standby voltage of 12.5 V, which remains stable after the access station load. Maintenance workers also inspected the waterproof connections and cable bends, as the low temperatures make the aging protective covers more likely to crack. Two straps showing signs of hardening are replaced and the stress release is re-fixed at the cable entrance. Before leaving the station, the team had the weather station run continuously for forty minutes, and the real-time data was easily compared with handheld thermometers and portable wind speedometers. This comparison does not replace formal calibration, but it does find a clear reduction in known risk and provides a clear background record for any subsequent abnormalities.

ZH12-01-校园照明节能改造的分区测试 一所综合院校准备更换两栋教学楼的走廊照明，但在全面采购之前，后勤部门先选择一个楼层做分 区测试。原有灯具使用时间较长，部分区域照度不均，夜间又常出现整层无人但灯光全开的情况。 试验区被分成普通走廊、楼梯口和自习区三类空间，每类空间分别记录白天、傍晚和夜间的照度与 用电情况。项目要求在降低能耗的同时，不能因为追求节电而造成明显的昏暗区域。 普通走廊安装了高效LED灯具和分组控制，自习区则保留较高照度。楼梯口增加了存在感应器，但 设置了延时关闭，避免人员短暂停留时灯光反复闪烁。调试初期，感应器在一个转角处出现盲区， 学生从侧门进入时有时不能及时触发。技术人员没有简单提高所有传感器的灵敏度，而是改变了其 中一个探头的安装角度，并把检测范围限制在主要通行区域，减少对隔壁房间活动的误触发。 两周运行结果 连续两周记录显示，试验楼层夜间照明用电量比改造前同期下降约31%，但后勤部门没有把这个比 例直接推广到整栋楼。考试周和普通教学周的使用规律不同，天气也会影响白天需要开灯的时间。 为了获得更可比的数据，下一阶段计划保留一层未改造区域作为参考，并在相同课表周期内同步记 录。自习区还增加了问卷二维码，用来收集对亮度和眩光的主观意见。 照度检查使用同一台经过核查的照度计，测点高度和位置保持一致。发现某处低于设计目标时，工 作人员先检查灯具是否被标牌遮挡，再决定是否调整布局。项目同时记录灯具型号、额定功率、安 装日期和控制器编号，便于后续维护时追踪。这样的记录遵免了“节能改造完成后就不再关注”的 情况，因为控制策略和实际使用方式仍可能随着学期变化。试验结束时，后勤部门把结果分成三 类：可以直接复制的安装做法、需要进一步观察的控制参数，以及不适合其他区域的局部方案。最 终采购数量将依据下一轮测试决定。这个过程虽然比一次性更换更慢，却减少了在整栋楼里重复同 一种错误的风险，也为以后评估节能效果留下了清楚的基线。

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
ZH12-01- Campus lighting energy-efficient transformation of district testing A comprehensive school is preparing to replace the corridor lighting in the two-storey school building, but the logistics department has chosen one floor to test the partitioning before the full procurement. There was a long use of lamps, uneven lighting in some areas, and at night there was often a situation where the whole floor was empty but the lights were on. The test area was divided into three categories of space: a common corridor, a stairway and a self-study area, each of which recorded lighting and electricity usage during the day, evening and night. The project requires that, while reducing energy consumption, no conspicuous dark areas can be created in the pursuit of energy savings. Normal corridors are equipped with efficient LED lighting and group controls, while the self-contained area maintains a high illumination. The staircase has an added presence sensor, but a delayed shutdown is set to prevent the lights from flashing repeatedly when personnel are stopped for a short time. In the early stages of the decoy, the sensor appears to have a blind spot at a corner, and students sometimes fail to trigger it in time when entering through a side door. Instead of simply improving the sensitivity of all sensors, the technicians changed the mounting angle of one of the probes and limited the detection range to the main passage area, reducing the mis-triggering of activity in adjacent rooms. Two-week run results For two consecutive weeks, records show that the nighttime lighting consumption on the test floors decreased by about 31% compared to the same period before the renovation, but the logistics department did not directly extend this proportion to the entire building. Exam week and regular school week are different, and the weather also affects the time of day when lights need to be turned on. In order to obtain more comparable data, the next stage is planned to keep an unmodified area as a reference layer and record it in sync during the same class cycle. The self-study area also added a two-dimensional questionnaire code to collect subjective opinions on brightness and fluorescence. The illumination is checked using the same verified illuminator and the height and position of the measuring point are consistent. When a location is found below the design target, the staff first checks whether the lighting is covered by the sign and then decides whether to adjust the layout. The project also records the lamp model, rated power, installation date and controller number for easy tracking during subsequent maintenance. Such records are not considered to be of interest to aluminum once the energy-saving conversion of aluminum is completed, as control strategies and actual usage patterns may still change as the semester progresses. At the end of the trial, the logistics department divided the results into three categories: installation practices that could be directly replicated, control parameters that needed further observation, and local solutions that were not suitable for other areas. The final number of purchases will be decided based on the next round of testing. This process, while slower than a one-time replacement, reduces the risk of repeating the same error throughout the building and provides a clear baseline for later evaluation of energy savings.

ZH12-02-社区图书馆自助归还系统试运行 一家社区图书馆在入口处安装了自助还书设备，希望在闭馆前后的高峰时段减少服务台排队。设备 通过射频标签识别图书，读者把书放入入口槽后，屏幕会显示识别结果并打印简短凭条。图书馆没 有立即取消人工还书窗口，而是安排四周试运行，对识别成功率、误报警、书箱容量和读者操作时 间进行记录。工作人员每天开馆前先检查设备内部是否有卡书或标签未读取的情况。 操作方式的调整 第一周最常见的问题并不是设备故障，而是读者一次放入多本书。系统虽然允许连续处理，但当三 四本书叠在一起进入时，标签位置不同会增加漏读概率。图书馆随后在入口处增加图示，要求一次 放入一本，并把屏幕提示从长句改成两步短指令。第二周的重复操作明显减少。对于没有射频标签 的旧书，设备会明确提示转交人工窗口，而不是把它们当作未知错误。 还书箱的容量也需要重新估算。原设计按平均书厚计算，但儿童绘本和大型画册会更快占满空间。 一次周末活动后，箱体在预计时间前约50分钟达到警戒线。工作人员根据记录调整了周末清空频 率，并在后台加入80%容量提醒。这个提醒只作为工作提示。仍要求工作人员实际查看箱内堆叠情 况，因为书本倾斜可能影响机械测量。 为了检查账户处理是否一致，技术人员每天随机抽取二十笔自助还书记录，与图书管理系统中的借 阅状态进行核对。发现时间戳不一致时，会保留原始日志并检查网络间步，而不是直接修改读者记 录。试运行第三周曾出现一次短暂断网，设备转入离线缓存模式，网络恢复后再同步。工作人员随 后验证了缓存队列中所有记录是否成功写入。四周结束后，自助设备被保留，但人工窗口仍继续开 放。图书馆认为成功的标准不是完全替代工作人员，而是让简单、标准的还书操作更顺畅，同时为 异常情况保留清听的人工处理路径。试运行形成的日志也成为后续维护依据，包括清箱时间，同络 中断、标签读取失放和读者取消操作等信息。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
ZH12-02- A community library has installed a self-return device at the entrance of a community library to reduce queues at service desks during peak hours before and after closing. The device identifies the book by means of a radiofrequency tag, and after the reader places the book in the input slot, the screen displays the identification results and prints a short credential. Instead of cancelling the manual return window immediately, the library arranged a four-week trial run to record the success rate of identification, false alarms, bookcase capacity and reader operation time. The staff checks every day before opening the facility for unread cards or labels. The most common problem in the first week of adjusting the operating system is not a device failure, but the reader placing multiple books at once. While the system allows for continuous processing, when three or four books are stacked together, different labeling locations increase the likelihood of misses. The library then added a sign at the entrance, asked to put in one book at a time, and changed the screen prompt from a long sentence to a two-step short instruction. The second week saw a marked decrease in repetition. For older books that do not have RF labels, the device will explicitly prompt to turn over the artificial windows instead of treating them as unknown errors. The capacity of the bookcase also needs to be re-estimated. The original design was based on an average book thickness, but children's drawings and large picture books filled the space faster. After a weekend activity, the tank reached the alert line about 50 minutes before the expected time. Staff adjusted the frequency of the weekend clearance based on the records and added an 80% capacity reminder in the background. This reminder is for work only. Staff are still required to actually inspect the stacking inside the box, as the tilt of the book may affect mechanical measurements. To check for consistency in the accounting process, technicians randomly extract twenty self-refund records per day to check with the borrowing status in the bookkeeping system. When a timestamp is found to be inconsistent, the original logs are kept and network pacing is checked, rather than the reader record being directly modified. During the third week of the trial, there was a brief outage, the device switched to offline caching mode, and the network was restored and synced again. Staff then verified that all records in the cache queue had been successfully written. At the end of the four weeks, the self-help equipment was retained, but the artificial window remained open. The library believes that the criteria for success are not to completely replace the staff, but to make simple, standard book returns work more smoothly, while preserving a clear path for exceptional cases. The logs formed during the trial run also serve as a basis for subsequent maintenance, including information such as check-in times, synchronization interruptions, label read misses, and reader cancellations.

ZH12-03-海边风机叶片的定期巡检记录 沿海试验场的一台小型风力机需要进行季度巡检。设备长期暴露在盐雾、强风和砂粒环境中，叶片 表面容易出现细小侵蚀。维护团队选择在风速较低的早晨停机检查，并按照锁定程序切断自动启动 功能。地面人员先确认叶轮完全停止，再使用望远镜和高分辨率相机观察三片叶片的前缘、根部和 排水孔。当天环境温度约23℃，平均风速低于4m/s。 与上一次记录相比，第二片叶片靠近尖端的位置出现一条约38毫米长的浅色磨损带。照片显示损 伤仍局限在表面涂层，没有看到明显裂纹。团队用同一拍摄角度和比例尺重新记录该区域，并在维 护图上标出位置。为了避免把光照反射误认为损伤，检查人员又从不同方向拍摄两张照片。三组图 像都能看到相同边界后，该点才被列入跟踪清单。 叶片根部的紧固区域没有发现松动迹象，但一个排水孔周围有盐结晶。技术人员使用规定的软工具 清理表面，没有扩大孔径。机舱外壳和电缆入口也同时检查，因为海边环境中的水汽可能从多个位 置进入。控制柜内的湿度指示片仍处于正常范围，接线端子没有明显变色。维护人员记录了这 些“未发现异常”的项目，避免下一次巡检无法判断某处是否曾经被检查。 恢复运行与复查条件 巡检完成后，风机以低转速恢复运行十五分钟。监控系统中的振动和转速曲线与停机前没有明显差 异。团队没有因此取消对叶尖磨损的后续观察，而是把复查时间设为六周后，并规定如果磨损长度 增长超过10毫米或出现裂纹，就提前安排更详细检查。这样可以在不过度维修的情况下保持明确 的触发条件。最终记录包括停机时间、天气条件、照片编号、检查项目和待办事项。所有照片保留 原始文件，不在归档版本中进行会改变细节的锐化处理。季度巡检的价值不仅在于发现问题，也在 于建立连续证据，使维护人员能够判断一个表面变化是稳定、缓慢发展还是需要立即处理。

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
ZH12-03- Regular patrol records of offshore fan blades A small wind turbine at a coastal test site needs quarterly patrol. Long-term exposure to salt fog, strong winds and sand particles can lead to minor erosion of the surface of the leaf. The maintenance team chooses to check the shutdown in the morning at a low wind speed and disconnect the auto-start function according to the locking procedure. The ground crew first confirms that the leaflet has completely stopped, and then uses telescopes and high-resolution cameras to observe the front edges, roots and drainage holes of the three leaflets. The daytime ambient temperature is about 23°C, with an average wind speed of less than 4 m/s. Compared to the previous record, the second leaf has a light-colored stripe of abrasion 38 mm long near the tip of the leaf. The photos show that the damage is still limited to the surface coating, with no visible cracks. The team re-recorded the area with the same angle and scale and marked the location on the maintenance map. In order to avoid mistaking the light reflection for damage, the inspector took two more photographs from different directions. When all three sets of images see the same boundary, the point is added to the tracking list. The tight areas of the leaf roots show no signs of loosening, but one drainage hole is surrounded by salt crystals. The technician uses the specified soft tools to clean the surface without enlarging the porosity. The cabin shell and cable entrances are also checked at the same time, as water vapour in the seaward environment may enter from multiple locations. The humidity indicator in the control cabinet is still in the normal range, and there is no noticeable discoloration of the wiring terminals. Maintenance personnel recorded the items where no abnormal leaks were found, so that the next inspection would not be able to determine if something had been inspected. After the restoration of operation and the review of conditions, the fan was restored to low speed for fifteen minutes. Vibration and speed curves in the monitoring system did not differ significantly from before the shutdown. The team did not cancel the follow-up observation of the leaf tip wear as a result, but instead set the review time to six weeks later and stipulated that more detailed examinations should be scheduled in advance if the wear length increases by more than 10 mm or if cracks occur. This allows for clear trigger conditions to be maintained without excessive maintenance. The final record includes downtime, weather conditions, photo numbering, check items and pending items. All photos retain their original file and are not subject to incubation which would alter the details in the archived version. The value of a quarterly patrol is not only in discovering problems, but also in establishing continuous evidence that enables maintenance personnel to judge whether a surface change is stable, slow-moving or needs immediate treatment.

The cabin shell and cable entrances are also checked at the same time, as water vapour in the seaward environment may enter from multiple locations. The humidity indicator in the control cabinet is still in the normal range, and there is no noticeable discoloration of the wiring terminals. Maintenance personnel recorded the items where no abnormal leaks were found, so that the next inspection would not be able to determine if something had been inspected. After the restoration of operation and the review of conditions, the fan was restored to low speed for fifteen minutes. Vibration and speed curves in the monitoring system did not differ significantly from before the shutdown. The team did not cancel the follow-up observation of the leaf tip wear as a result, but instead set the review time to six weeks later and stipulated that more detailed examinations should be scheduled in advance if the wear length increases by more than 10 mm or if cracks occur. This allows for clear trigger conditions to be maintained without excessive maintenance. The final record includes downtime, weather conditions, photo numbering, check items and pending items. All photos retain their original file and are not subject to incubation which would alter the details in the archived version. The value of a quarterly patrol is not only in discovering problems, but also in establishing continuous evidence that enables maintenance personnel to judge whether a surface change is stable, slow-moving or needs immediate treatment.

EN16-01 - Calibrating Portable Air-Quality Sensors A teaching laboratory received twelve portable air-quality monitors for a field course on indoor ventilation. Before students could use them, the instruments had to be checked against the laboratory reference station The monitors measured carbon dioxide, temperature and relative humidity, and they were expected to agree closely enough for comparative surveys. On 8 September 2026, the technician placed all units on the same bench for forty minutes so that their temperature could stabilize. Windows were kept closed, no one stood directly beside the sensors, and the reference station logged one reading every 30 seconds. Morning Calibration Sequence The first comparison showed that most carbon-dioxide readings were within 35 ppm of the reference, but two monitors differed by more than 90 ppm. Their humidity channels also responded slowly after a brief change in room conditions. Rather than applying a correction immediately, the technician inspected the intake openings and found a thin layer of packing dust on both units. After cleaning the vents with dry air and repeating the stabilization period, the large offsets disappeared. The event was recorded because it demonstrated that a poor result can come from handling and storage rather than from a failed sensing element For the final check, the room was occupied by six students for fifteen minutes, raising the carbon-dioxide level from approximately 510 ppm to 1.120 ppm. Each monitor had to follow the rise and fall without sudden steps or frozen values. The reference unit remained on mains power. while the portable units ran on their internal batteries. The slowest sensor reached 90% of the reference change in 74 seconds: the fastest required 41 seconds. These response times were acceptable for the planned room-to-room survey, which focused on ventilation trends rather than second-by-second exposure. The calibration record was printed and attached to the equipment case Students were instructed to repeat a short co-location check before every major field session and to note any unusual delay, battery warning or blocked vent. The procedure did not turn inexpensive monitors into laboratory instruments, but it established a traceable baseline for the course More importantly, it gave students a clear example of why measurement quality depends on preparation, environmental control and careful documentation, not only on the number shown on a display
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

EN16-03- Measuring Quiet Zones in a Public Library Survey Method A public library wanted to understand why visitors described one reading room as quiet even when the sound meter showed levels similar to those in another room. Staff designed a short acoustic survey using a calibrated handheld meter and a written observation sheet. Measurements were taken at five marked positions during three periods of the day. The meter was mounted 1.2 m above the floor and kept at least 1 m from walls or large furniture. Each sample lasted sixty seconds and recorded both the average sound level and the highest short-duration peak. The morning survey produced averages between 36.8 and 39.5 dBA During the afternoon, the values rose by roughly 4 dB as more people used the study tables. The highest peak, 61 2 dBA, occurred when a metal water bottle fell near the entrance. Surprisingly. the room that visitors considered calmer did not always have the lowest average level Observers noted that its sounds were more continuous: ventilation noise. turning pages and distant footsteps. In the other room, sudden chair movements and brief conversations were more noticeable even when the overall average remained modest Staff used the observations to test small changes rather than imposing strict silence rules Felt pads were added to twenty-four chair legs, a return trolley was moved away from the main reading area, and a soft- close strip was fitted to one cabinet door One week later the same measurement route was repeated. Average levels changed only slightly. but the number of peaks above 55 dBA fell from seventeen to nine during the busiest hour. Visitor comments also mentioned fewer abrupt interruptions. The survey showed that a single average number could not describe the entire experience of a space. Frequency, timing and character of sounds also mattered The library therefore kept the simple route as a quarterly check and added a column for notable sound events. This gave staff a repeatable way to evaluate practical changes without treating the sound meter as a complete measure of comfort The same marked positions were retained on a floor plan so that future measurements could be taken at comparable locations rather than wherever space happened to be available
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

EN12-01 - Managing Emergency Water Storage on a Campus A residential campus reviewed its emergency water plan after a scheduled pipeline repair lasted longer than expected. The existing guidance stated that each residence block should keep a small reserve, but it did not specify how often containers should be inspected or who was responsible for replacing them. A working group therefore mapped the locations of tanks, portable containers and drinking-water dispensers across eight buildings. The review focused on short interruptions lasting less than one day, because longer emergencies would require outside supply and a different distribution plan Storage and Inspection Rules The group estimated a minimum planning quantity of 3 litres of drinking water per person for a 24- hour period, with additional water needed for basic hygiene and food preparation Rather than filling every available container, staff selected food-grade vessels that could be sealed, labelled and moved safely Each label showed the fill date, intended use and responsible building Containers were kept away from direct sunlight, cleaning chemicals and fuel. The largest portable vessel weighed almost 24 kg when full, so it was placed on a low trolley instead of a high shelf. Inspection became the most important part of the new plan. On the first Monday of every month, a building representative checked seals, leaks, labels and storage conditions. Any container with a damaged cap, unusual odour or unclear history was emptied and cleaned rather than kept for convenience. The fixed tanks were included in the facilities maintenance schedule, with records of cleaning dates and inlet-screen condition. A small sample of stored water was also checked after long periods of non-use according to the campus health office procedure. A short exercise was held on 14 August 2026 One residence floor was told that tap water was unavailable for two hours, and volunteers practised retrieving, carrying and issuing the stored supply. The exercise revealed that the written map was accurate but one trolley could not pass through a narrow service doorway. Moving two containers to a different room solved the problem The group also learned that people needed clear instructions about which reserve was suitable for drinking and which was intended only for cleaning The final plan treated stored water as a managed resource rather than a pile of containers It assigned ownership, inspection intervals, safe lifting arrangements and a method for recording use. The reserve was modest, but the process reduced confusion during routine interruptions and provided a stronger starting point for larger emergency planning.

EN12-02 - A Pilot Bicycle Counter on a Campus Road A transport research class installed a temporary bicycle counter on a campus road to compare manual observations with an electronic sensing system. The site was chosen because it carried steady bicycle traffic but had only one vehicle lane in each direction, making visual verification practical. Two students marked a 12 m observation zone with removable tape and positioned the sensor so that passing bicycles crossed its detection area at a consistent angle Data collection began at 07 30 on 3 September 2026 and continued until 18 30. For validation, observers counted bicycles manually during six separate thirty-minute windows. They recorded direction, bicycle type and whether two riders passed side by side. The electronic counter stored a timestamp and direction estimate for every detected event. During the morning period. the system counted 146 bicycles while the observers counted 150. Review of the timestamps showed that most missed events occurred when pairs travelled close together. A second issue appeared when a grounds vehicle moved slowly along the edge of the detection zone and produced two false bicycle events. Installation Adjustment The class adjusted the installation rather than changing the data after collection The sensor was rotated by 7 degrees and moved 0 6 m farther from the road edge so that maintenance vehicles were less likely to enter its strongest detection region. The next validation window produced 132 electronic counts against 134 manual counts. Side-by-side riders still presented a challenge, but the false vehicle detections stopped Students noted that a small numerical improvement was useful only because the physical reason for the change was understood and documented Daily traffic patterns were also informative. The largest thirty-minute total occurred between 08 10 and 08 40, while a second peak appeared after classes ended. Rain beginning at 15 20 reduced bicycle traffic by approximately 38% compared with the previous dry hour The class did not treat this single day as representative of an entire semester: instead. ia used the exercise to practise installation, validation and uncertainty reporting At the end of the pilot, all temporary markings were removed and the dataset was archived with a site photograph, sensor orientation sketch and calibration notes. The main lesson was that automated counters can reduce labour, but they stull require field checks. Without manual observations, the class would not have known whether an unusual count reflected real travel behaviour. a passing service vehicle or limitations in separating closely spaced riders
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Rain beginning at 15 20 reduced bicycle traffic by approximately 38% compared with the previous dry hour The class did not treat this single day as representative of an entire semester: instead. ia used the exercise to practise installation, validation and uncertainty reporting At the end of the pilot, all temporary markings were removed and the dataset was archived with a site photograph, sensor orientation sketch and calibration notes. The main lesson was that automated counters can reduce labour, but they stull require field checks. Without manual observations, the class would not have known whether an unusual count reflected real travel behaviour. a passing service vehicle or limitations in separating closely spaced riders

EN12-03 - Digitizing Handwritten Field Notebooks A small environmental archive began digitizing field notebooks created by survey teams beween occasional measurements written in pencil. Because the originals were unique the project was designed around preservation first and speed second. Every notebook received a temporary work number, and staff photographed its cover and condition before scanning Pages with loose inserts were flagged so that no item would be lost when the binding was opened The scanning station used an overhead camera rather than a flalbed scanner because several bindings could not be pressed safely Pages were supported at a gentle angle and illuminaled by two diffuse lamps positioned to reduce glare A grey reference card appeared in the first image of each session Most pages were captured at 400 ppi equivalent resolution, while maps and pages containing very small annotations were recorded at higher resolution Operators checked focus al the centre and corners before continuing through a notebook. File naming was deliberately simple A notebook identified as FN-1994-17 produced images such as FN-1994-17_P001 and FN-1994-17_P002 If a loose insert belonged between pages 18 and 19, it received a suffix rather than forcing the rest of the sequence to be renamed A checksum was generated after transfer to the archive server, and a second copy was wriiten to offline storage The project log recorded the operator, capture date, equipment settings and any unusual page condition Access Copy Versus Original Evidence Text recognition was treated as an access aid, not a replacement for the image. Handwriting quality varied widely, and technical abbreviations often confused automated systems. Staff therefore created a short verified transcription only for titles, dates, locations and selected measurements Search users could find a notebook through those fields and then inspect the original page image Where a number was uncertain, the transcription included a visible uncertainty marker rather than silenily choosing a value. By the end of the first month. 2,480 pages had been captured from thirty-six notebooks. The team intentionally avoided setting a daily page quota because fragile material required different handling times. Instead, quality was reviewed through weekly sample checks of focus. sequence, colour reference and file integrity This slower but controlled workflow preserved the relationship between the digital files and the physical notebooks, which was more important than maximizing the number of scans completed each day

Field Evaluation of Wearable Translation Glasses A wearable translation system is most useful when it behaves like an ordinary tool rather than a laboratory demonstration The user should be able to face a printed page. pause briefly, and hear a clear rendering without holding a telephone or searching through menus In the prototype described here, a small camera is mounted near eye level and connected to a compact computer. Video is sent over a local link to a processing workstation where text detection, optical character recognition, language translation and speech synthesis are performed The complete pipeline operates without a cloud service This arrangement protects sensitive documents. avoids delays caused by an unstable internet connection. and allows every software component to be measured independently Image acquisition is the first major difficulty. A person wearing glasses cannot easily see whether all four edges of a page are inside the camera view. The page may be tilted. partly shadowed. or closer at the top than at the bottom. Motion from breathing and head movement also creates blur. The capture controller therefore examines every incoming frame before saving it It locates groups of text. estimates whether the document occupies a useful fraction of the image, and checks that a safe border remains around the detected region Sharpness is measured over the whole frame and again over the upper portion. because a slanted sheet often appears clear near the bottom while the first lines remain soft A frame is accepted only after several consecutive observations agree Spoken prompts tell the wearer to step back, move left or right, hold still or improve the lighting After capture, the image is converted to grayscale and corrected only when the correction improves measured recognition Excessive sharpening can create bright halos around letters, while aggressive thresholding can erase punctuation and thin strokes For that reason several preprocessing alternatives are tested on the same stored photographs The comparison includes raw grayscale. local contrast enhancement, mild gamma correction, edge-preserving fitering. and Ground-truth text is retained for important experiments so that character confidence alone

SOURCE     : After capture, the image is converted to grayscale and corrected only when the correction improves measured recognition Excessive sharpening can create bright halos around letters. while aggressive thresholding can erase punctuation and thin strokes For that reason, several preprocessing alternatives are tested on the same stored photographs The comparison includes raw grayscale. local contrast enhancement mild gamma correction, edge-preserving fitering. and adaptive binarization Each alternative is evaluated using character count recognition confidence. focus statistics. and processing time Ground-truth text is retained for important experiments so that character error rate and word error rate can be calculated instead of relying on confidence alone

Document Recognition System Modern document-reading systems combine optical character recognition with layout analysis. OCR identifies printed words, while layout models determine how information is arranged on the page. Tables require special processing because their meaning depends on rows, columns and headers. The following table summarizes the main processing modules used in a typical intelligent reading pipeline. Module Function Output PaddleOCR Recognizes printed text Text Table Detector Finds table regions Bounding box Structure Model Finds rows and columns Table layout RoBERTa Answers text questions Answer Table 1. Main modules of the document-probessing pipeline System Operation After a page is captured, OCR extracts the visible words. If a table is detected, the table region is processed separately so that individual values remain associated with the correct headings. This structured representation can later be translated, searched or converted into speech. Preserving the document structure therefore makes spoken output easier for a user to understand.

偏远地区混合能源站的自主监测与维护 一座高原试验站依靠太阳能阵列、锂电池和小型柴油发电机供 电。微电网需要持续支持诊所、无线电中继、气象设备和安全照 明。冬季道路可能封闭数日，网络也不稳定，因此本地控制器每 二百毫秒采集电压、电流、温度与振动数据，并在能源不足时优 先保障医疗和通信负载。完整记录保存在站内，只有压缩后的状 态摘要会在链路恢复时发送到控制中心。 二〇二五年十月十八日，一场沙尘风暴使太阳能输出在十五分 钟内下降百分之三十四，电池柜温度升高八摄氏度，逆变器风扇 还出现异常低频振动。控制器没有关闭整座电站，而是断开非必 要加热装置、降低部分照明功率并启动备用发电机。诊断模块随 后提出三个可能原因：太阳能板被碎屑遮挡、风扇轴承磨损，以 及电池连接器的接触电阻上升。 风暴减弱后，技术员用头戴式摄像设备读取铭牌、序列号和报 警代码，本地处理单元再与离线维护手册进行比对。由干资料涉 及关键基础设施，图像没有上传云端。采集程序先确认整个标签 位于安全边界内，并分别检查全图和上部区域的清晰度：若画面 被裁切，耳机会提示向左、向右或向后移动。目标只有连续四帧 稳定且文字足够清楚时才会保存。第二天的日志表明，自动排序 与人工判断一致：先清理面板，再更换风扇轴承，最后紧固电池 端子。处置用了六分钟，关键服务未中断。这说明可靠的自动 必须解释判断、承认不确定性，并把最终决定留给人。

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Autonomous monitoring and maintenance of hybrid power stations in remote areas A plateau test station relies on solar arrays, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator to power it. Micro-grids need to continue to support clinics, radio relay, weather equipment and safety lighting. Roads can be closed for days in winter and the network is unstable, so local controllers collect voltage, current, temperature and vibration data every 200 milliseconds, and prioritize medical and communications loads when energy is scarce. The complete record is stored on the station, and only the compressed status summary is sent to the control center when the link is restored. On October 18, 2025, a dust storm caused a 34 percent drop in solar output in fifteen minutes, a temperature rise of eight degrees Celsius in the battery cabinet, and an abnormally low frequency vibration in the inverter fan. Instead of shutting down the entire power plant, the controller disconnects unnecessary heating devices, lowers the power of some lighting and starts the backup generator. Diagnostic modules then suggested three possible causes: solar panels were shrouded in debris, fan bearings wore out, and the contact resistance of the battery connector rose. After the storm weakened, technicians used head-mounted cameras to read the insignia, serial numbers and alarm codes, and the local processing unit was compared to the offline maintenance manual. The images are not uploaded to the cloud because of the critical infrastructure involved. The capture process first confirms that the entire label is within the safety boundary and checks the clarity of the whole image and the upper region separately: if the image is cropped, the earpiece is prompted to move left, right or backwards. The target is saved only when the sequence of four lines is stable and the text is clear enough. The next day's logs showed that the automatic sorting was consistent with the artificial judgment: first the panels were cleaned, then the fan bearings were replaced, and finally the battery terminals were tightened. The disposal took six minutes and critical services were not interrupted. This shows that reliable automation must interpret judgments, acknowledge uncertainty, and leave the final decision to humans.

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Autonomous monitoring and maintenance of hybrid power stations in remote areas A plateau test station relies on solar arrays, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator to power it. Micro-grids need to continue to support clinics, radio relay, weather equipment and safety lighting. Roads can be closed for days in winter and the network is unstable, so local controllers collect voltage, current, temperature and vibration data every 200 milliseconds, and prioritize medical and communications loads when energy is scarce. The complete record is stored on the station, and only the compressed status summary is sent to the control center when the link is restored. On October 18, 2025, a dust storm caused a 34 percent drop in solar output in fifteen minutes, a temperature rise of eight degrees Celsius in the battery cabinet, and an abnormally low frequency vibration in the inverter fan. Instead of shutting down the entire power plant, the controller disconnects unnecessary heating devices, lowers the power of some lighting and starts the backup generator. Diagnostic modules then suggested three possible reasons for the shredded solar panels, fan bearing wear, and increased contact resistance of the battery connector. After the storm weakened, technicians used head-mounted cameras to read the insignia, serial numbers and alarm codes, and the local processing unit was compared to the offline maintenance manual. The images were not uploaded to the cloud because the material involved critical infrastructure. The capture process first confirms that the entire label is within the safety boundary and checks the clarity of the whole image and the upper area separately: if the image is cropped, the headset prompts to move left, right or backwards. The target is saved only when the sequence of four lines is stable and the text is clear enough. The next day's logs showed that the automatic sorting was consistent with the artificial judgment: first the panels were cleaned, then the fan bearings were replaced, and finally the battery terminals were tightened. The disposal took six minutes and critical services were not interrupted. This shows that reliable automation must interpret judgments, acknowledge uncertainty, and leave the final decision to humans.

Surveillance autonome d'une station énergétique isolée Sur un plateau difficile d'accès, une station alimente un dispensaire un relais radio, des instruments météorologigues et l'éclairage de securité. Le micro-réseau réunit des panneaux solaires, des batteries au lithium et un petit générateur diesel Comme la route peut rester fermée plusieurs jours, un contrôleur mesure la tension. le courant. la température et les vibrations toutes les 200 millisecondes Les données detaillées restent sur place: seul un résumé compressé est transmis lorsque la liaison fonctionne Les équipements médicaux et de communication sont prioritaires Le 18 octobre 2025, une tempéte de poussière a réduit la production solaire de 34 % en quinze minutes La température de l'armoire de batteries a augmenté de 8 °C, tandis que le ventilateur de londuleur produisait une vibration anormale Au lieu d'arrêter la station, le système a coupé le chauffage secondaire, réduit certains éclairages et démarre le groupe de secours Il a identifié trois causes possibles: des débris sur les panneaux, un roulement usé et une résistance croissante dans un connecteur de batterie Après la tempête, une caméra portée sur la tête a lu les plaques et les codes d'alarme, puis un processeur local les a comparés au manuel hors ligne Aucune image sensible n'a été envoyée dans le nuage Le logiciel exigeait que l'étiquette entière reste dans une marge süre, il contrôlait aussi la netteté générale et celle de la partie supérièure Une consigne sonore demandait de reculer si un bord manquait, et quatre images stables étaient nécessaires Les ingenieurs ont ensuite confirmé l'ordre proposé nettoyer les panneaux, remplacer le roulement. puis resserrer le connecteur. L'intervention a durè six minutes sans interrompre un service critique Une automatisation fiable doit reconnaitre l'incertitude et laisser la decision finale à l'opérateur
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a hard-to-reach shelf, a station feeds a medical clinic a radio relay, weather instruments and security lighting. The micro-grid is made up of solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator. As the road may remain closed for several days, a controller measures the voltage. The current. temperature and vibrations every 200 milliseconds Detailed data remains in place: only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is working Medical equipment and communication are priority On October 18, 2025, a dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in fifteen minutes The temperature of the battery cabinet rose by 8 °C, while the windshield fan produced an abnormal vibration Instead of shutting down the station, the system cut off the secondary heating, reduced some lighting and started the rescue group He identified three possible causes: debris on the panels, worn bearing and increasing resistance in a battery connector After the storm, a head-mounted camera read the plates and alarm codes, then a local processor compared them to the offline manual No sensitive images were sent to the cloud The software required the entire tag to remain within a certain margin, it also controlled the overall sharpness and that of the upper part An audible signal asked to back off if an edge was missing, and four stable images were needed The engineers then confirmed the proposed order to clean the panels, replace the bearing. Then tighten the connector. The intervention lasted six minutes without interrupting a critical service reliable automation must recognize uncertainty and leave the final decision to the operator
