EXTRACTED TEXT:
Surveillance autonome d'une station énergétique isolée Sur un plateau difficile d'accès, une station alimente un dispensaire, un relais radio, des instruments météorologiques et l'éclairage de sécurité. Le micro-réseau réunit des panneaux solaires, des batteries au lithium et un petit générateur diesel. Comme la route peut rester fermée plusieurs jours, un contrôleur mesure la tension, le courant, la température et les vibrations toutes les 200 millisecondes. Les données détaillées restent sur place; seul un résumé compressé est transmis lorsque la liaison fonctionne. Les équipements médicaux et de communication sont prioritaires Le 18 octobre 2025, une tempête de poussière a réduit la production solaire de 34 % en quinze minutes. La température de l'armoire de batteries a augmenté de 8 °C, tandis que le ventilateur de l'onduleur produisait une vibration anormale. Au lieu d'arrêter la station, le système a coupé le chauffage secondaire, réduit certains éclairages et démarré le groupe de secours Ill a identifié trois causes possibles des débris sur les panneaux, un roulement usé et une résistance croissante dans un connecteur de batterie Après la tempête, une caméra portée sur la tête a lu les plaques et les codes d'alarme, puis un processeur local les a comparés au manuel hors ligne. Aucune image sensible n'a été envoyée dans le nuage Le logiciel exigeait que l'étiquette entière reste dans une marge süre, il contrôlait aussi la netteté générale et celle de la partie supérieure Une consigne sonore demandait de reculer si un bord manquait, et quatre images stables étaient nécessaires Les ingénieurs ont ensuite confirmé l'ordre proposé nettoyer les panneaux, remplacer le roulement. puis resserrer le connecteur. L'intervention a duré six minutes sans reconnaître l'incertitude et laisser la décision finale à l'opérateur.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a hard-to-reach plateau, one station feeds a dispensary, a radio relay, weather instruments and safety lighting. The micro-grid is made up of solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator. Since the road can remain closed for days, a controller measures voltage, current, temperature and vibration every 200 milliseconds. Detailed data remains in place; only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is operational. Medical equipment and communication are a priority On October 18, 2025, a dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in fifteen minutes. The temperature of the battery compartment rose by 8°C, while the inverter fan produced an abnormal vibration. Instead of shutting down the station, the system turned off the secondary heating, reduced some of the lights and started the rescue team. Ill identified three possible causes of debris on the panels, a worn bearing and increasing resistance in a battery connector. After the storm, a head-mounted camera read the license plates and alarm codes, and then a local processor compared them to the offline manual. No sensitive images were sent to the cloud The software required the entire label to remain within a certain range, it also controlled the overall sharpness and the sharpness of the upper part An audible command asked to back up if an edge was missing, and four stable images were needed The engineers then confirmed the proposed order to clean the panels, replace the bearing. Then tighten the connector. The intervention lasted six minutes without acknowledging the uncertainty and leaving the final decision to the operator.

EXTRACTED TEXT:
Surveillance autonome d'une station énergétique isolée Sur un plateau difficile d'accés, une station alimente un dispensaire, un relais radio, des instruments météorologiques et l'éclairage de sécurité Le micro-réseau réunit des panneaux solaires, des batteries au lithium et un petit générateur diesel Comme la route peut rester fermée plusieurs jours, un contrôleur mesure la tension, le courant, la température et les vibrations toutes les 200 millisecondes. Les données détaillées restent sur place: seul un résumé compressé est transmis lorsque la liaison fonctionne Les équipements médicaux et de communication sont prioritaires Le 18 octobre 2025, une tempête de poussière a réduit la production solaire de 34 % en quinze minutes La température de l'armoire de batteries a augmenté de 8 C, tandis que le ventilateur de l'onduleur produisait une vibration anormale Au lieu d'arrêter la station, le système a coupé le chauffage secondaire, réduit certains éclairages et démarré le groupe de secours Il a identifié trois causes possibles des débris sur les panneaux, un roulement usé et une résistance croissante dans un connecteur de batterie Après la tempête, une caméra portée sur la tête a lu les plaques et les codes d'alarme, puis un processeur local les a comparés au manuel hors ligne Aucune image sensible n'a été envoyée dans le nuage Le logiciel exigeait que l'étiquette entière reste dans une marge süre, il contrôlait aussi la netteté générale et celle de la partie supérieure Une consigne sonore demandait de reculer si un bord manquait, et quatre images stables étaient nécessaires Les ingénieurs ont ensuite confirme l'ordre propose nettoyer les panneaux, remplacer le roulement. puis resserrer le connecteur L'intervention a duré six minutes sans interrompre un service critique Une automatisation fiable doit reconnaitre l'incertitude et laisser la décision finale à l'operateur
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a difficult-to-reach plateau, a station feeds a dispensary, a radio relay, weather instruments and safety lighting The micro-network includes solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator As the road can remain closed for several days, a controller measures voltage, current, temperature and vibrations every 200 milliseconds. Detailed data remains in place: only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is operational Medical and communication equipment is a priority On October 18, 2025, a dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in fifteen minutes The temperature of the battery cabinet rose by 8 C, while the inverter fan produced an abnormal vibration Instead of shutting down the station, the system cut off the secondary heating, reduced some lighting and started the backup group He identified three possible causes of debris on the panels, a worn bearing and increasing resistance in a battery connector After the storm, a head-mounted camera read the plates and alarm codes, then a local processor compared them to the offline manual No sensitive images were sent to the cloud The software required the entire tag to remain within a certain timeframe, it also controlled the overall sharpness and that of the upper part An audible command asked to back off if an edge was missing, and four stable images were needed The engineers then confirmed the order suggesting to clean the panels, replace the bearing. Then tighten the connector The intervention lasted six minutes without interrupting a critical service Reliable automation must recognize uncertainty and leave the final decision to the operator

EXTRACTED TEXT:
偏远地区混合能源站的自主监测与维护 一座高原试验站依靠太阳能阵列、锂电池和小型柴油发电机供 电。微电网需要持续支持诊所、无线电中继、气象设备和安全照 明。冬季道路可能封闭数日，网络也不稳定，因此本地控制器每 二百毫秒采集电压、电流、温度与振动数据，并在能源不足时优 先保障医疗和通信负载。完整记录保存在站内，只有压缩后的状 态摘要会在链路恢复时发送到控制中心。 二〇二五年十月十八日，一场沙尘风暴使太阳能输出在十五分 钟内下降百分之三十四，电池柜温度升高八摄氏度，逆变器风扇 还出现异常低频振动。控制器没有关闭整座电站，而是断开非必 要加热装置、降低部分照明功率并启动备用发电机。诊断模块随 后提出三个可能原因太阳能板被碎屑遮挡、风扇轴承磨损，以 及电池连接器的接触电阻上升。 风暴减弱后，技术员用头戴式摄像设备读取铭牌、序列号和报 警代码，本地处理单元再与离线维护手册进行比对。由干资料涉 及关键基础设施，图像没有上传云端。采集程序先确认整个标签 位于安全边界内，并分别检查全图和上部区域的清晰度：若画面 被载切，耳机会提示向左、向右或向后移动。目标只有连续四帧 稳定且文字足够清楚时才会保存。第二天的日志表明，自动排序 与人工判断一致先清理面板，再更换风扇轴承，最后紧固电池 端子。处置用了六分钟，关键服务未中断。这说明可靠的自动化 必须解释判断、承认不确定性，并把最终决定留给人。

دور دراز علاقوں میں ہائبرڈ پاور سٹیشنوں کی خود مختار نگرانی اور بحالی ایک ہائی لینڈ ٹیسٹنگ اسٹیشن کو شمسی توانائی سے چلنے والی ایک صف، لیٹینیم بیٹریاں اور ایک چھوٹا ڈیزل جنریٹر سے بجلی فراہم کی جاتی ہے۔ مائیکرو نیٹ ورکس کو کلینک، ریڈیو ریلیز، موسمیاتی سامان اور حفاظتی لائٹنگ کی مسلسل مدد کی ضرورت ہے۔ موسم سرما میں سڑکیں کئی دن بند رہ سکتی ہیں اور نیٹ ورک غیر مستحکم ہوتا ہے۔ اس لیے مقامی کنٹرولرز صرف کمپریسڈ حالت کا خلاصہ کنٹرول سینٹر کو بھیجا جاتا ہے جب لنک بحال ہوتا ہے۔ 18 اکتوبر 2025 کو ، ایک دھول کے طوفان نے پندرہ منٹ میں شمسی توانائی کی پیداوار میں 34 فیصد کمی کی ، بیٹری کی ٹوکری کا درجہ اضافہ ہے۔ طوفان کے بعد ، تکنیکی ماہرین نے سر پر رکھے ہوئے کیمرے کا استعمال کرتے ہوئے نشانات ، سیریل نمبر اور الارم کوڈ پڑھے ، اور مقامی پروسیسنگ یونٹ کو آف لائن بحالی کے دستی سے موازنہ کیا۔ تصویر کو گیا۔ اس کے بعد سے ، اس نے اپنے صارفین کو بتایا کہ وہ اس کے بارے میں کیا سوچتے ہیں: اس سے پتہ چلتا ہے کہ قابل اعتماد آٹومیشن کو فیصلے کی ترجمانی کرنی ہوگی ، غیر یقینی صورتحال کو تسلیم کرنا ہوگا اور EXTRACTED TEXT:
Field Evaluation of Wearable Translation Glasses A wearable translation system is most useful when it behaves like an ordinary tool rather than a laboratory demonstration. The user should be able to face a printed page, pause briefly, and hear a clear rendering without holding a telephone or searching through menus. In the prototype described here, a small camera is mounted near eye level and connected to a compact computer. Video is sent over a local link to a processing workstation, where text detection, optical character recognition, language translation and speech synthesis are performed. The complete pipeline operates without a cloud service This arrangement protects sensitive documents, avoids delays caused by an unstable internet connection. and allows every software component to be measured independently Image acquisition is the first major difficulty A person wearing glasses cannot easily see whether all four edges of a page are inside the camera view. The page may be tilted, partly shadowed. or closer at the top than at the bottom Motion from breathing and head movement also creates blur. The capture controller therefore examines every incoming frame before saving it It locates groups of text, estimates whether the document occupies a useful fraction of the image, and checks that a safe border remains around the detected region Sharpness is measured over the whole frame and again over the upper portion. because a slanted sheet often appears clear near the bottom while the first lines remain soft A frame is accepted only after several consecutive observations agree Spoken prompts tell the wearer to step back, move left or right hold still or improve the lighting confidence alone

Field Evaluation of Wearable Translation Glasses (پہلے پہننے کے قابل ترجمہ شیشے کی فیلڈ تشخیص) A wearable translation system is most useful when it behaves like an ordinary tool rather than a laboratory demonstration. ایک پہننے کے قابل ترجمے کا نظام زیادہ مفید ہے جب یہ لیبارٹری کے مظاہرے کی بجائے ایک عام آلے کی طرح برتاؤ کرتا ہے۔ The user should be able to face a printed page, pause briefly, and hear a clear rendering without holding a phone or searching through menus. صارف کو ایک پرنٹ شدہ صفحے کا سامنا کرنے کے قابل ہونا چاہئے، مختصر طور پر روکنا چاہئے، اور فون کو پکڑنے یا مینو کے ذریعے تلاش کرنے کے بغیر واضح رینڈرنگ سننا چاہئے. یہاں بیان کردہ پروٹوٹائپ میں، ایک چھوٹا کیمرہ آنکھ کی سطح کے قریب نصب کیا جاتا ہے اور ایک کمپیکٹ کمپیوٹر سے منسلک ہوتا ہے. ویڈیو ایک مقامی لنک پر ایک پروسیسنگ ورک سٹیشن پر بھیجا جاتا ہے، جہاں متن کا پتہ لگانے، آپٹیکل کردار کی شناخت، زبان ترجمہ اور تقریر کی ترکیب انجام دی جاتی ہے. The complete pipeline operates without a cloud service یہ انتظام حساس دستاویزات کی حفاظت کرتا ہے، ایک غیر مستحکم انٹرنیٹ کنکشن کی وجہ سے تاخیر سے بچتا ہے. and allows every software component to be measured independently اور ہر سافٹ ویئر کے جزو کو آزادانہ طور پر ماپا جا سکتا ہے تصویری حصول پہلی بڑی مشکل ہے ایک شخص جو شیشے پہنتا ہے وہ آسانی سے نہیں دیکھ سکتا کہ صفحے کے چاروں کناروں کو کیمرے کے نظارے کے اندر ہے یا نہیں۔ The page may be tilted, partly shadowed. صفحہ جھکا دیا جا سکتا ہے، جزوی طور پر سایہ دار. or closer at the top than at the bottom سانس لینے اور سر کی حرکت سے بھی دھندلا پن پیدا ہوتا ہے۔ The capture controller therefore examines every incoming frame before saving it It locates groups of text, estimates whether the document occupies a useful fraction of the image, and checks that a safe border remains around the detected region Sharpness is measured over the whole frame and again over the upper portion. اس کے نتیجے میں ، گرفتاری کا کنٹرولر اس کو بچانے سے پہلے ہر آنے والے فریم کا جائزہ لیتا ہے۔ یہ متن کے گروپوں کا پتہ لگاتا ہے ، اندازہ لگاتا ہے کہ آیا دستاویز تصویر کے ایک مفید حصے پر قبضہ کرتا ہے ، اور چیک کرتا ہے کہ پتہ لگانے والے علاقے کے آس پاس ایک محفوظ سرحد باقی رہتی ہے۔ because a slanted sheet often appears clear near the bottom while the first lines remain soft A frame is accepted only after several consecutive observations agree Spoken prompts tell the wearer to step back, move left or right hold still or improve the lighting (کیونکہ ایک جھکا ہوا شیٹ اکثر نیچے کے قریب صاف نظر آتا ہے جبکہ پہلی لائنیں نرم رہتی ہیں) A frame is accepted only after several consecutive observations agree Spoken prompts tell the wearer to step back, move left or right hold still or improve the lighting اکیلے اعتماد

Field Evaluation of Wearable Translation Glasses A wearable translation system is most useful when it behaves like an ordinary tool rather than a laboratory demonstration The user should be able to face a printed page pause briefly, and hear a clear rendering without holding a telephone or searching through menus. In the prototype described here, a small camera is mounted near eye level and connected to a compact computer Video is sent over a local link to a processing workstation, where text detection, optical character recognition, language translation. and speech synthesis are performed. The complete pipeline operates without a cloud service This arrangement protects sensitive documents. avoids delays caused by an unstable internet connection and allows every software component to be measured independently Image acquisition is the first major difficulty A person wearing glasses cannot easily see whether all four edges of a page are inside the camera view The page may be tilted, partly shadowed, or closer at the top than at the bottom Motion from breathing and head movement also creates blur The capture controller therefore examines every incoming frame before saving it It locates groups of text. estimates whether the document occupies a useful fraction of the image, and checks that a safe border remains around the detected region Sharpness is measured over the whole frame and again over the upper portion, because a slanted sheet often appears clear near the bottom while the first lines remain soft A frame is accepted only after several consecutive observations agree Spoken prompts tell the wearer to step back, move left or right, hold still or improve the lighting After capture, the image is converted to grayscale and corrected only sharpening can create bright halos around letters, while aggressive confidence alone

the control cabinet stores detailed measurements locally Voltage. current temperature. fan speed. and vibration are sampled every two hundred miliseconds Only compressed summaries are transmitted when the radio link becomes available and medical and communications loads always receive priority During a dust storm on 18 October 2025, solar output fell by thirty-four percent in fifteen minutes Battery-cabinet temperature rose by eight degrees Celsius. and the inverter fan developed an unusual low- frequency vibration The controller did not shut down the entire station It disconnected secondary heaters. reduced selected lighting. started the backup generator. and issued a maintenance warning Diagnostic software identified three plausible faults debris covering part of the solar array. wear in a fan bearing. and increasing contact resistange at a battery connector These possibilities were ranked. but none was presented as certain because the measurements could be explained by more than one physical condition When the storm weakened a technician approached the cabinet while wearing a head-mounted camera and an earplece Equlpment labels contained model numbers. safety notices. alarm codes. and short repair instructions in several languages The local translation system first checked whether the complete label was visible It rejected frames with a missing edge heavy glare. severe perspective distortion or poor sharpness in the upper region Four stable frames were required before a photograph was stored If the target was too close. the earpiece asked the technician to step backward If the label was off centre, a simple left or right instruction was played These cues were deliberately brief so they would not compete with environmental sounds or safety communication Accepted images were processed on a workstation inside the service vehicle Text boxes were arranged in reading order and grouped into paragraphs The offline translation model passed one EXTRACTED TEXT:
Offline Inspection at a Remote Energy Facility A maintenance team operates a hybrid-energy station on a dry plateau several hours from the nearest town. The station supplies a medical room. a radio repeater, weather instruments, refrigeration, and emergency lighting Solar panels provide most of the daily energy. lithium batteries cover the evening demand. and a compact diesel generator is reserved for long storms Because winter roads can remain closed for days, the control cabinet stores detailed measurements locally Voltage. current, temperature, fan speed, and vibration are sampled every two hundred milliseconds Only compressed summaries are transmilted when the radio link becomes available, and medical and communications loads always receive priority During a dust storm on 18 October 2025, solar output fell by thirty-four percent in fifteen minutes Battery-cabinet temperature rose by eight degrees Celsius. and the inverter fan developed an unusual low- frequency vibration. The controller did not shut down the entire station. It disconnected secondary heaters, reduced selected lighting. started the backup generator. and issued a maintenance warning Diagnostic software identified three plausible faults debris covering part of the solar array. wear in a fan bearing, and increasing contact resistance at a battery connector These possibilities were ranked. but none was presented as certain because the measurements could be explained by more than one physical condition When the storm weakened, a technician approached the cabinet while wearing a head-mounted camera and an earpiece Equipment labels contained model numbers, safety notices, alarm codes, and short repair instructions in several languages. The local translation system first checked whether the complete label was visible It rejected frames with a missing edge. heavy glare, severe perspective distortion, or poor sharpness in the upper region Four stable frames were required before a photograph was stored If the target was too close, the earpiece asked the technician to step backward. If the label was off centre, a simple left or right instruction was played. These cues were deliberately brief so they would not compete with environmental sounds or safety communication Accepted images were processed on a workstation inside the service vehicle Text boxes were arranged in reading order and grouped into paragraphs The offline translation model passed one region at a time to the speech engine, and a brief tone marked every transition

The station supplies a medical room. a radio repeater, weather instruments, refrigeration, and emergency lighting. SOURCE     : A maintenance team operates a hybrid-energy station on a dry plateau several hours from the nearest town. The station supplies a medical room. a radio repeater, weather instruments, refrigeration, and emergency lighting. Solar panels provide most of the daily energy. lithium batteries cover the evening demand, and a compact diesel generator is reserved for long storms. Because winter roads can remain closed for days, the control cabinet stores detailed measurements locally. Voltage. current, temperature, fan speed. and vibration are sampled every two hundred milliseconds. Only compressed summaries are transmitted when the radio link becomes available, and medical and communications loads always receive priority

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a hard-to-reach plateau, a station feeds a dispensary, a radio relay, weather instruments and safety lighting The microgrid includes solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator As the road may remain closed for several days. A controller measures the voltage, the current. temperature and vibrations every 200 milliseconds Detailed data remains in place, only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is working Medical equipment and communication are priority On 18 October 2025, a dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in 15 minutes. The temperature of the battery compartment rose by 8 °C. Instead of shutting down the station, the system turned off the secondary heating, reduced some of the lights, and started the rescue team. It identified three possible causes of debris on the battery connector. After the storm, a head-mounted camera read the license plates and alarm codes. No sensitive images were sent to the cloud. The software required that the entire tag remain within a safe margin. The engineers then confirmed the proposed order to clean the panels, replace the bearing, and then tighten the connector The operation lasted six minutes without acknowledging the uncertainty and leaving the final decision to the operator

Surveillance autonome d'une station énergétique isolée Sur un plateau difficile d'accès, une station alimente un dispensaire, un relais radio. des instruments météorologiques et l'éclairage de sécurite Le micro-réseau reunit des panneaux solaires, des batteries au lithium et un petit générateur diesel Comme la route peut rester fermée plusieurs jours. un contrôleur mesure la tension le courant la température et les vibrations toutes les 200 millisecondes Les données détaillées restent sur place; seul un resumé compressé est transmis lorsque la liaison fonctionne Les équipements médicaux et de communication sont prioritaires Le 18 octobre 2025. une tempête de poussière a réduit la production solaire de 34 % en quinze minutes La température de l'armoire de batteries a augmente de 8 °C. tandis que le ventilateur de l'onduleur produisait une vibration anormale Au lieu d'arrêter la station, le système a coupé le chauffage secondaire. réduit certains éclairages et démarré le groupe de secours Il a identifié trois causes possibles des débris sur les panneaux, un roulement usé et une résistance croissante dans un connecteur de batterie Après la tempête, une caméra portée sur la tête a lu les plaques et les codes d alarme. puis un processeur local les a comparès au manuel hors ligne Aucune image sensible n'a eté envoyée dans le nuage Le logiciel exigeait que l'étiquette entière reste dans une marge súre, il contrôlait aussi la netteté génerale et celle de la partie supérieure Une consigne sonore demandait de reculer si un bord manquait, et quatre images stables etalent nécessaires Les ingénieurs ont ensuite confirme l'ordre proposé nettoyer les panneaux, remplacer le roulement, puis resserrer le connecteur L'intervention a dure six minutes sans interrompre un service critique Une automatisation fiable doit reconnaitre l'incertitude et laisser la décision finale a l'opérateur

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a hard-to-reach plateau, a power station feeds a medical clinic, a radio relay. The microgrid is made up of solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator as the road may remain closed for several days. A controller measures voltage, current, temperature and vibration every 200 milliseconds Detailed data remains in place; only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is working Medical and communication equipment is a priority It's the 18th of October 2025. A dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in 15 minutes. The temperature of the battery compartment rose by 8°C. Instead of shutting down the station, the system cut off the secondary heating. He identified three possible causes of the debris on the panels, a worn-out bearing and increasing resistance in a battery connector. After the storm, a head-mounted camera read license plates and alarm codes. Then a local processor compared them to the offline manual No sensitive image was sent to the cloud The software required that the entire tag remain in a safe margin, it also controlled the overall sharpness and that of the top part A sound command asked to back up if an edge was missing, and four stable images were needed Then the engineers confirmed the proposed order to clean the panels, replace the bearing, then tighten the connector The intervention lasted six minutes without interrupting a critical service A reliable automation must recognize uncertainty and leave the final decision to the operator

TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
DOLL Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a hard-to-reach plateau, a station feeds a dispensary, a radio relay of weather instruments and safety lighting. The micro-grid is made up of solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator. As the road may remain closed for several days, a controller measures the voltage. the current, temperature and vibration every 200 milliseconds. Detailed data remains in place, only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is operational Medical and communication equipment is a priority It's the 18th of October 2025. A dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in 15 minutes. The temperature of the battery compartment rose by 8°C. Instead of shutting down the station, the system turned off the secondary heating, reduced some of the lighting and started the backup unit. He identified three possible causes of debris on the panels, a worn-out bearing and increasing resistance in a battery connector. After the storm, a head-mounted camera read the license plates and offline. No sensitive images were sent to the cloud.

Surveillance autonome d'une station énergétique isolée Sur un plateau difficile d'accès, une station alimente un dispensaire, un relais radio, des instruments météorologiques et l'éclairage de sécurité. Le micro-réseau réunit des panneaux solaires, des batteries au lithium et un petit générateur diesel. Comme la route peut rester fermée plusieurs jours, un contrôleur mesure la tension, le courant, la température et les vibrations toutes les 200 millisecondes. Les données détaillées restent sur place, seul un résumé compressé est transmis lorsque la liaison fonctionne Les équipements médicaux et de communication sont prioritaires Le 18 octobre 2025, une tempête de poussière a réduit la production solaire de 34 % en quinze minutes La température de l'armoire de batteries a augmenté de 8 °C. tandis que le ventilateur de l'onduleur produisait une vibration anormale Au lieu d'arrêter la station, le système a coupé le chauffage secondaire, réduit certains éclairages et démarré le groupe de secours Il a identifie trois causes possibles des débris sur les panneaux, un roulement usé et une résistance croissante dans un connecteur de batterie Après la tempête, une caméra portée sur la tête a lu les plaques et les codes d'alarme. puis un processeur local les a comparés au manuel hors ligne. Aucune image sensible n'a été envoyée dans le nuage Le logiciel exigeait que l'étiquette entière reste dans une marge sure, il contrôlait aussi la netteté générale et celle de la partie supérieure Une consigne sonore demandait de reculer si un bord manquait, et quatre images stables étaient nécessaires. Les ingénieurs ont ensuite confirme l'ordre proposé nettoyer les panneaux, remplacer le roulement, puis resserrer le connecteur. L'intervention a duré six minutes sans reconnaitre l'incertitude et laisser la décision finale à l'opérateur
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a hard-to-reach plateau, one station feeds a dispensary, a radio relay, weather instruments and safety lighting. The micro-grid is made up of solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator. Since the road can remain closed for days, a controller measures voltage, current, temperature and vibration every 200 milliseconds. Detailed data remains in place, only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is operational Medical and communication equipment is a priority On 18 October 2025, a dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in fifteen minutes. Instead of shutting down the station, the system turned off the secondary heating, reduced some of the lights, and started the backup unit. It identified three possible causes of debris on the panels, worn bearings, and increasing resistance in a battery connector. After the storm, a head-mounted camera read the license plates and alarm codes. Then a local processor compared them to the offline manual. No sensitive images were sent to the cloud The software required the entire label to remain within an acidic margin, it also controlled the overall sharpness and that of the upper part A sound command asked to back up if an edge was missing, and four stable images were needed. The engineers then confirmed the proposed order to clean the panels, replace the bearing, and then tighten the connector. The procedure lasted for six minutes without any acknowledge the uncertainty and leave the final decision to the operator

EXTRACTED TEXT:
Paragraph-Level Translation and Spoken Guidance Reading a complete translated page as uninterrupted speech creates a serious usability problem The listener hears the meaning but cannot tell which original line or paragraph is currently being spoken. This becomes especially confusing on technical documents containing warnings, numbered procedures. labels. and tables A wearable translator should preserve the connection between physical text and audio. The processing pipeline therefore retains the coordinates returned by optical character recognition and groups nearby lines into meaningful regions Each region becomes a separate translation unit instead of sending the entire page to the language model at once Reading order is determined from position, alignment, and spacing. Lines that share a similar left edge and remain within a reasonable vertical distance are combined. Large gaps. headings. bullet points. and changes in indentation begin new groups The original coordinates remain attached to every translated sentence During development. the selected paragraph is surrounded by a coloured box in the preview In the wearable version, a short tone and a spoken paragraph number announce the same transition The user can move forward. go back, repeat. pause, or stop with a small physical control or a limited voice command set Speech is generated only after a paragraph passes basic checks. Empty results and very low recognition confidence request another image. Extremely long regions are divided at sentence boundaries, while short neighbouring lines may be joined so the voice does not pause after every label fragment Numbers, units, dates, and warning symbols receive special attention because a fluent sentence can still be dangerous when one measurement is wrong. The interface can optionally read the source paragraph first and the translated paragraph second This to notice recognition mistakes before acting on the result

REGION P1 | ID=2 | TYPE=paragraph | BBOX=(524, 95, 1134, 371) | CONFIDENCE=0.993
SOURCE     : Reading a complete translated page as uninterrupted speech creates a serious usability problem The listener hears the meaning but cannot tell which original line or paragraph is currently being spoken. This becomes especially confusing on technical documents containing warnings, numbered procedures. labels. and tables A wearable translator should preserve the connection between physical text and audio. The processing pipeline therefore retains the coordinates returned by optical character recognition and groups nearby lines into meaningful regions Each region becomes a separate translation unit instead of sending the entire page to the language model at once

SOURCE     : Reading order is determined from position, alignment, and spacing. Lines that share a similar left edge and remain within a reasonable vertical distance are combined. Large gaps. headings. bullet points. and changes in indentation begin new groups The original coordinates remain attached to every translated sentence During development. the selected paragraph is surrounded by a coloured box in the preview In the wearable version, a short tone and a spoken paragraph number announce the same transition The user can move forward. go back, repeat. pause, or stop with a small physical control or a limited voice command set

EXTRACTED TEXT:
Designing Reliable Automatic Page Capture Automatic page capture seems simple until the camera is worn on the head The user cannot continuously inspect a preview. and small movements alter framing. focus. and perspective. A page that looks acceptable from a distance may have its first lines outside the image or noticeably softer than the lower half Indoor lighting adds reflections. while daylight produces deep shadows near the page edge The capture system must therefore decide when a frame is useful and communicate corrections through sound It should not save the first image containing text. because detection often begins while the wearer is still moving into position The proposed gate combines geometry, focus, exposure, and temporal stability Text boxes are detected in each video frame and merged into a candidate region The outer region must remain inside a safety margin so no line is cropped Its width and height must also fall within practical limits a tiny region provides too few pixels per character, but a region touching the image boundary probably indicates that part of the page is missing Focus is estimated from Laplacian variance over the ful grayscale frame. A second measurement covers the upper thirty percent. where slanted paper is commonly out of focus A capture is rejected when the upper score is much lower than the full-frame score, even if the overall number appears satisfactory One sharp frame is not sufficient evidence The position and size of the text region must remain stable across four consecutive observations. With the selected video interval, this adds roughly eight tenths of a second after the page first appears ready The delay is short for the wearer but long enough for hand and head motion to settle Exposure changes are monitored during the same period if brightness is still drifting, the counter returns to zero When the page is too large, spoken guidance hold still or adjust distance

REGION P1 | ID=2 | TYPE=paragraph | BBOX=(450, 204, 1008, 455) | CONFIDENCE=0.989
SOURCE     : Automatic page capture seems simple until the camera is worn on the head The user cannot continuously inspect a preview. and small movements alter framing. focus. and perspective. A page that looks acceptable from a distance may have its first lines outside the image or noticeably softer than the lower half Indoor lighting adds reflections. while daylight produces deep shadows near the page edge The capture system must therefore decide when a frame is useful and communicate corrections through sound It should not save the first image containing text. because detection often begins while the wearer is still moving into position

REGION P2 | ID=3 | TYPE=paragraph | BBOX=(462, 455, 1023, 728) | CONFIDENCE=0.991
SOURCE     : The proposed gate combines geometry, focus, exposure, and temporal stability Text boxes are detected in each video frame and merged into a candidate region The outer region must remain inside a safety margin so no line is cropped Its width and height must also fall within practical limits a tiny region provides too few pixels per character, but a region touching the image boundary probably indicates that part of the page is missing Focus is estimated from Laplacian variance over the ful grayscale frame. A second measurement covers the upper thirty percent. where slanted paper is commonly out of focus A capture is rejected when the upper score is much lower than the full-frame score, even if the overall number appears satisfactory

REGION P3 | ID=4 | TYPE=paragraph | BBOX=(475, 728, 1034, 999) | CONFIDENCE=0.990
SOURCE     : One sharp frame is not sufficient evidence The position and size of the text region must remain stable across four consecutive observations. With the selected video interval, this adds roughly eight tenths of a second after the page first appears ready The delay is short for the wearer but long enough for hand and head motion to settle Exposure changes are monitored during the same period if brightness is still drifting, the counter returns to zero When the page is too large, spoken guidance hold still or adjust distance

Field Evaluation of Wearable Translation Glasses able to face a printed page. pause briefly, and hear a clear rendering without holding a telephone or searching through menus. In the prototype to a compact computer. Video is sent over a local link to a processing workstation, where text detection, optical character recognition, language translation and speech synthesis are performed The complete pipeline operates without a cloud service This arrangement protects sensitive documents. avoids delays caused by an unstable internet connection. and allows every software component to be measured independently Image acquisition is the first major difficulty A person wearing glasses cannot easily see whether all four edges of a page are inside the camera view The page may be tilted partly shadowed, or closer at the top than at the bottom Motion from breathing and head movement also creates blur The capture controller therefore examines every incoming frame before saving it It locates groups of text. estimates whether the document occupies a useful fraction of the image, and checks that a safe border remains around the detected region Sharpness is measured over the whole frame and again over the upper portion because a slanted sheet often appears clear near the bottom while the first lines remain soft A frame is accepted only after several consecutive observations agree Spoken prompts tell the wearer to step back, move left or right, hold still or improve the lighting After capture, the image is converted to grayscale and corrected only photographs The comparison includes raw grayscale. local contrast enhancement, mild gamma correction, edge-preserving filtering, and count, recognition confidence, focus statistics, and processing time Ground-truth text is retained for important experiments so that character error rate and word error rate can be calculated instead of relying on confidence alone

Surveillance autonome d'une station énergétique isolée Sur un plateau difficile d'accès, une station alimente un dispensaire. un relais radio. des instruments météorologiques et l'éclairage de sécurité Le micro-réseau réunit des panneaux solaires, des batteries au lithium et un petit générateur diesel Comme la route peut rester fermée plusieurs jours, un contrôleur mesure la tension. le courant. la température et les vibrations toutes les 200 millisecondes. Les données détaillées restent sur place, seul un résumé compressé est transmis lorsque la liaison fonctionne Les équipements médicaux et de communication sont prioritaires Le 18 octobre 2025, une tempête de poussière a réduit la production solaire de 34 % en quinze minutes La température de l'armoire de batteries a augmente de 8 °C, tandis que le ventilateur de l'onduleur produisait une vibration anormale Au lieu d'arrêter la station. le système a coupe le chauffage secondaire, réduit certains éclairages et démarré le groupe de secours Il a identifié trois causes possibles des débris sur les panneaux, un roulement usé et une résistance croissante dans un connecteur de batterie Après la tempête, une caméra portée sur la tête a lu les plaques et les codes d'alarme, puis un processeur local les a comparès au manuel hors ligne Aucune image sensible n'a été envoyée dans le nuage Le logiciel exigeait que l'étiquette entière reste dans une marge süre contrôlait aussi la netteté générale et celle de la partie supérieure Une consigne sonore demandait de reculer si un bord manquait et quatre images stables étaient nécessaires. Les ingénieurs ont ensuite confirmé l'ordre proposé nettoyer les panneaux, remplacer le roulement puis resserrer le connecteur. L'intervention a duré six minutes sans interrompre un service critique Une automatisation fiable doit reconnaitre l'incertitude et laisser la décision finale à l'opérateur
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATED TEXT (ENGLISH):
Self-monitoring of an isolated power station On a hard-to-reach shelf, a station feeds a dispensary. It's a radio relay. The microgrid is made up of solar panels, lithium batteries and a small diesel generator. As the road may be closed for several days, a voltage meter is used. The current. temperature and vibration every 200 milliseconds. Detailed data remains in place, only a compressed summary is transmitted when the link is operational Medical and communication equipment is a priority On 18 October 2025, a dust storm reduced solar output by 34% in fifteen minutes. The temperature of the battery cabinet rose by 8 °C, while the inverter fan produced an abnormal vibration instead of shutting down the station. The system turned off the secondary heating, reduced some of the lights, and started the rescue group. He identified three possible causes of the debris on the panels, a worn bearing, and increasing resistance in a battery connector. After the storm, a head-mounted camera read the license plates and alarm codes, then a local processor compared them to the offline manual No sensitive images were sent to the cloud The software required the entire tag to remain within a certain margin also controlled the overall sharpness and that of the top part A voice command asked to back off if an edge was missing and four stable frames were needed. The engineers then confirmed the proposed order of cleaning the panels, replacing the bearing, and tightening the connector. The intervention lasted six minutes without interrupting a critical service reliable automation must recognize uncertainty and leave the final decision to the operator
